# file opened: zpolice.asm
   1  0000              ;==============================================================================
   2  0000              ; Z-POLICE  -  3D vector city flight for the ZX Spectrum Next
   3  0000              ;
   4  0000              ;  Z80N assembler (sjasmplus --zxnext).  Layer 2 256x192x8bpp, double buffered.
   5  0000              ;  The 3D viewport is the top 256x128; the bottom third is an instrument panel.
   6  0000              ;  Maths: world positions are 16-bit integers (one city cell = 256 units),
   7  0000              ;         trig values are S7.8 fixed point (1.0 = $0100).
   8  0000              ;  Hidden line removal: painter's algorithm. Buildings are walked over the
   9  0000              ;  grid far-to-near (no sort needed). Each visible face is filled in its
  10  0000              ;  shade (roof lighter, side turned away darker) and optionally outlined, so
  11  0000              ;  nearer buildings overwrite those behind them. Faces with every corner on
  12  0000              ;  screen use cached projections; faces crossing the view frustum are
  13  0000              ;  clipped in 3D (Sutherland-Hodgman, 5 planes). Rasterisation then only
  14  0000              ;  ever sees on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
  15  0000              ;
  16  0000              ;  Controls: Q/A speed up/down   Z air brake O/P turn left/right
  17  0000              ;            W/S climb/descend   E/D nose up/down
  18  0000              ;            SPACE fire          1-5 select weapon slot
  19  0000              ;            0 change the centre slot's weapon
  20  0000              ;
  21  0000              ;  Source files: zpolice.asm (resident main code), memory_bank_defs.asm
  22  0000              ;  (slots and pages).  Game logic pages, swapped into slot 6 at $C000:
  23  0000              ;  player.asm (input/movement), weapons.asm, menu.asm (main menu).  Core
  24  0000              ;  function pages, swapped into slot 7 at $E000: city.asm (Layer 2
  25  0000              ;  drawing), hud.asm (ULA HUD), input.asm (redefinable keys, joysticks), sprites.asm
  26  0000              ;  (hardware sprites).  Always mapped: zombie.asm at $2000, human.asm and
  27  0000              ;  map.asm (the city map) at $7000.
  28  0000              ;
  29  0000              ;  Memory while running:
  30  0000              ;    $0000-$1FFF  Layer 2 back buffer, one 8K section at a time (slot 0)
  31  0000              ;    $2000-$3FFF  zombie page (slot 1)
  32  0000              ;    $4000-$7FFF  occlusion data; cell colours, humans, map (slots 2-3)
  33  0000              ;    $8000-$9FFF  ULA screen (slot 4)
  34  0000              ;    $A000-$BFFF  resident code, tables, variables, stack (slot 5)
  35  0000              ;    $C000-$DFFF  game logic page (slot 6)
  36  0000              ;    $E000-$FFFF  core function page (slot 7)
  37  0000              ;==============================================================================
  38  0000
  39  0000                      DEVICE ZXSPECTRUMNEXT
  40  0000                      SLDOPT COMMENT WPMEM, LOGPOINT, ASSERTION
  41  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
  42  0000                      CSPECTMAP "release_tmp/zpolice.map"
  43  0000                  ELSE
  44  0000 ~                    CSPECTMAP zpolice.map
  45  0000                  ENDIF
  46  0000                      OPT --zxnext=cspect --syntax=a --reversepop
  47  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48  0000              ; Build options
  49  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  50  0000              ; RELEASE: the build for players (-DRELEASE: build.bat release).  Turns off
  51  0000              ; everything for testing, whatever is set below: the DEBUG_ settings, DRAW_FPS
  52  0000              ; and DOTS_ALL, a START_LEVEL_SET, a START_SALVAGE.  It's assembled into
  53  0000              ; release_tmp/, so the debug build's files (and the tests') stay as they are.
  54  0000
  55  0000              ; REAL_HARDWARE: the build for a real Next (-DREAL_HARDWARE: build.bat
  56  0000              ; hardware), which may use DMA+ (the zxnDDMA, the blitter of core 3.03.00, see
  57  0000              ; layer2_cls.asm).  Off, the DMA routines use only the plain zxnDMA, as CSpect
  58  0000              ; doesn't have DMA+ yet.  The .nex then also asks for core 3.03.00: on an older
  59  0000              ; core DMA+'s commands would be misread, not ignored.
  60  0000                      ;DEFINE REAL_HARDWARE
  61  0000
  62  0000              ; DRAW_LINES: outline building faces with EDGE_COL vectors.  Comment it out for solid-colour buildings only; the HUD
  63  0000              ; is always drawn.  Can also be set from the command line: -DDRAW_LINES
  64  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_LINES
  65  0000
  66  0000              ; WAIT_FOR_VBLANK: wait for the raster to leave the display area before
  67  0000              ; flipping the Layer 2 buffers (no tearing).  Comment it out to flip as soon
  68  0000              ; as a frame is drawn: faster, but the flip may tear mid-screen.
  69  0000              ; Command line: -DWAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  70  0000                      ;DEFINE WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  71  0000
  72  0000              ; DRAW_FPS: measure frames per second from the raster (vtick) and show it at
  73  0000              ; the top left of the ULA screen.  Comment it out to drop the measuring and
  74  0000              ; the display.  Command line: -DDRAW_FPS
  75  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_FPS
  76  0000
  77  0000              ; SKY_IS_WALL: the camera can never rise above the perimeter wall, so fill
  78  0000              ; the sky in the wall's colour and draw wall cells only up to camera height
  79  0000              ; (their top edge is then exactly the horizon).  No sky is ever seen.
  80  0000              ; Command line: -DSKY_IS_WALL
  81  0000                      DEFINE SKY_IS_WALL
  82  0000
  83  0000              ; OCCLUSION_CULL: in level flight, record the buildings, then cull those
  84  0000              ; completely hidden behind nearer ones (a per-column cover buffer, front to
  85  0000              ; back) before drawing the rest.  Uses pages PAGE_OCC0/1 at $4000-$7FFF.
  86  0000              ; Command line: -DOCCLUSION_CULL
  87  0000                      DEFINE OCCLUSION_CULL
  88  0000
  89  0000              ; LEVEL_FAST_PATH: while pitch is 0 (level flight) a building's top corners
  90  0000              ; have the same camera X and Z as the bottom corners below them, so each top
  91  0000              ; corner reuses its bottom corner's screen x and 1/Z and only works out its
  92  0000              ; screen y.  Comment it out to project every corner in full.
  93  0000              ; Command line: -DLEVEL_FAST_PATH
  94  0000                      DEFINE LEVEL_FAST_PATH
  95  0000
  96  0000              ; CLIP_2D: a face that crosses only the screen's sides, top or bottom, and is
  97  0000              ; within a guard band (|X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z), has its corners projected to
  98  0000              ; 16-bit screen coordinates and is clipped against the screen in 2D, not in
  99  0000              ; 3D (no new points to project, one multiply per new point, not three).
 100  0000              ; Faces crossing the near plane, or outside the guard band, are clipped in
 101  0000              ; 3D as before.  Comment it out to clip every face in 3D.
 102  0000              ; Command line: -DCLIP_2D
 103  0000                      DEFINE CLIP_2D
 104  0000
 105  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
 106  0000                    IFDEF DRAW_FPS
 107  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DRAW_FPS
 108  0000                    ENDIF
 109  0000                    IFDEF DOTS_ALL
 110  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DOTS_ALL
 111  0000                    ENDIF
 112  0000                    IFDEF START_LEVEL_SET
 113  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE START_LEVEL_SET
 114  0000                    ENDIF
 115  0000                  ENDIF

# file opened: memory_bank_defs.asm
   1+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 0000              ; Z-POLICE - memory bank definitions
   3+ 0000              ;
   4+ 0000              ; The Next maps its RAM into the Z80's 64K as eight 8K MMU slots, each set by
   5+ 0000              ; a NextReg ($50-$57) to an 8K page (page n = half of 16K bank n/2).  This
   6+ 0000              ; file names the slots, their registers and addresses, what each slot is
   7+ 0000              ; used for, and which page holds what.  Use:
   8+ 0000              ;   nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY            ; page the city code in at $E000
   9+ 0000              ;   MMU CODE_SLOT e, PAGE_CITY, CODE_ADDR ; (sjasmplus) assemble into it
  10+ 0000              ;
  11+ 0000              ; Memory map (see README.md):
  12+ 0000              ;   slot 0 $0000  Layer 2 sections (32 rows each) while drawing; the sine
  13+ 0000              ;                 table (PAGE_SIN) whenever get_sin reads it
  14+ 0000              ;   slot 1 $2000  zombie page, always mapped: zombies, humans, the HUD
  15+ 0000              ;                 map, the IM 2 table
  16+ 0000              ;   slot 2 $4000  occlusion data
  17+ 0000              ;   slot 3 $6000  the city bank (always mapped): city_col at $6000,
  18+ 0000              ;                 city_map at $7000, loaded from the level's city file
  19+ 0000              ;   slot 4 $8000  ULA screen (page 10, the first half of bank 5)
  20+ 0000              ;   slot 5 $A000  resident main code, variables, stack (page 11, the unused
  21+ 0000              ;                 second half of bank 5)
  22+ 0000              ;   slot 6 $C000  game logic pages, swapped: player, weapons, menu, level
  23+ 0000              ;                 loading
  24+ 0000              ;   slot 7 $E000  core function pages, swapped: city (Layer 2 drawing), HUD,
  25+ 0000              ;                 keys, sprites; a sprite bank while it is loaded; the
  26+ 0000              ;                 start-up set-up (initialise.asm) once
  27+ 0000              ; So game logic in slot 6 can call any core page in slot 7: main_loop pages
  28+ 0000              ; the keys in at $E000 while the player and weapons pages run at $C000.
  29+ 0000              ; At start-up the NEX loader's default mapping is in place (slot 6 = page
  30+ 0000              ; 0), so the entry point is a stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000 (boot, zpolice.asm)
  31+ 0000              ; that maps the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
  32+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
  33+ 0000
  34+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  35+ 0000              ; MMU slots: number, NextReg, address
  36+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  37+ 0000              MEMBANK_SIZE            equ $2000       ; 8K a slot / page
  38+ 0000
  39+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0              equ 0
  40+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1              equ 1
  41+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2              equ 2
  42+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3              equ 3
  43+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4              equ 4
  44+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5              equ 5
  45+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6              equ 6
  46+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7              equ 7
  47+ 0000
  48+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER     equ $50
  49+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER     equ $51
  50+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER     equ $52
  51+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER     equ $53
  52+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER     equ $54
  53+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER     equ $55
  54+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER     equ $56
  55+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER     equ $57
  56+ 0000
  57+ 0000              membank0                equ $0000
  58+ 0000              membank1                equ $2000
  59+ 0000              membank2                equ $4000
  60+ 0000              membank3                equ $6000
  61+ 0000              membank4                equ $8000
  62+ 0000              membank5                equ $A000
  63+ 0000              membank6                equ $C000
  64+ 0000              membank7                equ $E000
  65+ 0000
  66+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  67+ 0000              ; What each slot is used for: <use>_SLOT, <use>_MMU (its NextReg) and
  68+ 0000              ; <use>_ADDR (the ORG of code or data assembled for it)
  69+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  70+ 0000              ; slot 0: one 32-row section of a Layer 2 buffer at a time (seg_map etc.)
  71+ 0000              L2SEC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_0
  72+ 0000              L2SEC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  73+ 0000              L2SEC_ADDR              equ membank0
  74+ 0000              ; slot 0 also: the sine table, paged in by get_sin (resident).  Only the
  75+ 0000              ; game logic calls it, never the drawing, and every Layer 2 writer maps its
  76+ 0000              ; own section first, so the two never meet.  Nothing may write to
  77+ 0000              ; $0000-$1FFF while it is mapped.
  78+ 0000              SIN_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_0
  79+ 0000              SIN_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  80+ 0000              SIN_ADDR                equ membank0
  81+ 0000
  82+ 0000              ; slot 1: zombie.asm, human.asm, map.asm, interrupts.asm, always mapped
  83+ 0000              ZOMBIE_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_1
  84+ 0000              ZOMBIE_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER
  85+ 0000              ZOMBIE_ADDR             equ membank1
  86+ 0000
  87+ 0000              ; slot 2: occlusion buffer, draw list and building records (OCCLUSION_CULL)
  88+ 0000              OCC_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_2
  89+ 0000              OCC_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  90+ 0000              OCC_ADDR                equ membank2
  91+ 0000
  92+ 0000              ; slot 3: the city bank, always mapped: city_col at $6000, city_map at
  93+ 0000              ; $7000, read from the level's city file (level_load.asm) in one go
  94+ 0000              TABLES_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_3
  95+ 0000              TABLES_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER
  96+ 0000              TABLES_ADDR             equ membank3            ; city_col
  97+ 0000              CITYMAP_ADDR            equ membank3+$1000      ; city_map
  98+ 0000
  99+ 0000              ; slot 4: the ULA screen (bank 5's first 8K: bitmap and attributes)
 100+ 0000              ULA_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_4
 101+ 0000              ULA_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 102+ 0000              ULA_ADDR                equ membank4
 103+ 0000              ; slot 4 also: the second city page (city2.asm), over the ULA screen while
 104+ 0000              ; main_loop draws the city (nothing then uses the ULA screen)
 105+ 0000              CITY2_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_4
 106+ 0000              CITY2_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 107+ 0000              CITY2_ADDR              equ membank4
 108+ 0000
 109+ 0000              ; slot 5: resident main code (zpolice.asm), tables, variables, stack
 110+ 0000              MAIN_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_5
 111+ 0000              MAIN_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER
 112+ 0000              MAIN_ADDR               equ membank5
 113+ 0000
 114+ 0000              ; slot 6: game logic pages, swapped (player, weapons, menu)
 115+ 0000              LOGIC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_6
 116+ 0000              LOGIC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER
 117+ 0000              LOGIC_ADDR              equ membank6
 118+ 0000              ; slot 6 at start-up: the boot stub (the NEX loader maps page 0 there)
 119+ 0000              BOOT_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_6
 120+ 0000              BOOT_ADDR               equ membank6
 121+ 0000
 122+ 0000              ; slot 7: core function pages, swapped (city / Layer 2, HUD, keys, sprites)
 123+ 0000              CODE_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_7
 124+ 0000              CODE_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 125+ 0000              CODE_ADDR               equ membank7
 126+ 0000              ; slot 7 also: a sprite pattern bank (sprite_data.asm), paged in to run
 127+ 0000              ; its own loader, spr_load_bank
 128+ 0000              SPRBANK_SLOT            equ MMU_SLOT_7
 129+ 0000              SPRBANK_MMU             equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 130+ 0000              SPRBANK_ADDR            equ membank7
 131+ 0000
 132+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 133+ 0000              ; 8K pages
 134+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 135+ 0000              PAGE_BOOT               equ 0           ; the NEX entry stub (slot 6 at load)
 136+ 0000              PAGE_CITY               equ 1           ; city.asm: Layer 2 drawing (slot 7)
 137+ 0000              PAGE_HUD                equ 2           ; hud.asm: ULA (Layer 1) HUD (slot 7)
 138+ 0000              PAGE_PLAYER             equ 3           ; player.asm: input, movement,
 139+ 0000                                                      ; collision (slot 6)
 140+ 0000              PAGE_WEAPONS            equ 4           ; weapons.asm: player weapons (slot 6)
 141+ 0000              PAGE_ZOMBIE             equ 5           ; zombie.asm (slot 1, always)
 142+ 0000              PAGE_OCC0               equ 6           ; occlusion buffer, draw list and
 143+ 0000                                                      ; building records (slot 2)
 144+ 0000              PAGE_OCC1               equ 7           ; the city bank: city_col and
 145+ 0000                                                      ; city_map (slot 3, always)
 146+ 0000              PAGE_MENU               equ 8           ; menu.asm: main menu (slot 6)
 147+ 0000              PAGE_SPR0               equ 9           ; sprite_data.asm: sprite pattern
 148+ 0000                                                      ; bank 0 (slot 7 while loading);
 149+ 0000                                                      ; more banks: the next free pages
 150+ 0000              PAGE_ULA0               equ 10          ; the ULA screen, bank 5 (slot 4)
 151+ 0000              PAGE_MAIN               equ 11          ; zpolice.asm, resident (slot 5): the
 152+ 0000                                                      ; second half of bank 5
 153+ 0000              PAGE_INPUT              equ 12          ; input.asm: keyboard, joysticks (slot 7)
 154+ 0000              PAGE_SPRITES            equ 13          ; sprites.asm: hardware sprites
 155+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 7)
 156+ 0000              PAGE_SIN                equ 14          ; sin_tables.asm: the sine table
 157+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 0, read by get_sin)
 158+ 0000              PAGE_INIT               equ 15          ; initialise.asm: start-up set-up,
 159+ 0000                                                      ; initgame (slot 7, once)
 160+ 0000              PAGE_FILE               equ 16          ; file_handler.asm: SD card loading
 161+ 0000                                                      ; and saving (slot 7)
 162+ 0000              PAGE_AUDIO              equ 17          ; audio.asm: sound set-up (slot 7)
 163+ 0000              PAGE_SPECIAL            equ 31          ; specials.asm: special monsters
 164+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 6)
 165+ 0000              PAGE_LOADOUT            equ 32          ; loadout.asm: the load-out screen
 166+ 0000                                                      ; between levels (slot 6)
 167+ 0000              PAGE_KEYDEF             equ 33          ; keydef.asm: the redefine keys
 168+ 0000                                                      ; screen (slot 6)
 169+ 0000              PAGE_CITY2              equ 34          ; city2.asm: more Layer 2 drawing
 170+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 4, with the city page)
 171+ 0000              PAGE_GFX0               equ 35          ; the figures' graphics (from page 35,
 172+ 0000                                                      ; GFX_PAGES_MAX at most), loaded from
 173+ 0000                                                      ; ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG at start-up; each
 174+ 0000                                                      ; mapped at $C000 (slot 6) to draw
 175+ 0000              PAGE_LEVEL              equ 30          ; level_load.asm: level and city
 176+ 0000                                                      ; files (slot 6); pages 18-29 are
 177+ 0000                                                      ; the Layer 2 buffers
 178+ 0000
 179+ 0000              ; Layer 2 double buffer, in 16K banks (NextReg $12 / $13 take banks; the
 180+ 0000              ; pages are bank * 2).  Layer 2 is clipped to 192 rows, so each buffer
 181+ 0000              ; uses three banks.
 182+ 0000              L2_BANK_A               equ 9           ; 16K banks 9-11 (pages 18-23)
 183+ 0000              L2_BANK_B               equ 12          ; 16K banks 12-14 (pages 24-29)
 184+ 0000              PAGE_L2_A               equ L2_BANK_A*2
 185+ 0000              PAGE_L2_B               equ L2_BANK_B*2
 186+ 0000

 119  0000
 120  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 121  0000              ; Tuning constants
 122  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 123  0000              ; Scale: one map tile (cell) is 20 m x 20 m = 256 world units, and one
 124  0000              ; height unit (building heights, the ceiling, the pad) is 10 m = 128 world
 125  0000              ; units.  World units are the same size on every axis, so 1 m = 12.8 units
 126  0000              ; and 1 unit = 7.8 cm.  The city is 64 x 64 tiles = 1280 m.
 127  0000              ; Speeds are per rendered frame, so real speed depends on the frame rate
 128  0000              ; (figures below are at 14 fps).
 129  0000              GRID            equ 64          ; the city is GRID x GRID tiles (gentables.py)
 130  0000              ; A city_map byte: bits 0-4 the cell code (0 road, 1-15 building height
 131  0000              ; level, PAD_CODE, TERRACE_CODE, VOID_CODE: out of bounds), bit 6 set while a human waits in the cell
 132  0000              ; (human.asm, hum_flags), bit 7 while a zombie or special monster stands in
 133  0000              ; it (zombie.asm, zflags; its type is in its record).  Bit 5 is free.  So
 134  0000              ; every reader masks with CELL_CODE before testing for road or a code.
 135  0000              CELL_CODE       equ %00011111
 136  0000              CELL_FLAGS      equ %11100000       ; (the marks, kept when the code changes)
 137  0000              CELL_HUMAN_B    equ 6
 138  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE_B   equ 7
 139  0000              CELL_HUMAN      equ 1<<CELL_HUMAN_B
 140  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE     equ 1<<CELL_ZOMBIE_B
 141  0000              TILE_M          equ 20          ; metres per tile (reference scale)
 142  0000              TILE_UNITS      equ 256         ; world units per tile
 143  0000              HEIGHT_M        equ 10          ; metres per height unit
 144  0000              HEIGHT_UNITS    equ 128         ; world units per height unit
 145  0000              NEAR            equ 16          ; near clip plane: 1.25 m
 146  0000              VIEW_R          equ 8           ; most draw distance: buildings within +/- 8
 147  0000                                              ; tiles (160 m).  Each level sets its own,
 148  0000                                              ; 2..VIEW_R (view_r; night, fog), and the
 149  0000                                              ; street dots' radius one less (dot_r)
 150  0000              PMAX            equ 24          ; pitch limit (256 = 360 deg) - match gentables.py
 151  0000              SPEED_MAX       equ 28          ; units/frame: 2.2 m/frame, ~31 m/s (110 km/h)
 152  0000              SPEED_MIN       equ -6          ; reverse: 0.47 m/frame, ~6.6 m/s
 153  0000              YAW_RATE        equ $0180       ; turn per frame, 8.8 fixed (1.5 units;
 154  0000                                              ; 256 units = 360 degrees)
 155  0000              YAW_FINE        equ 256*256/360 ; the first frame of a turn: 1 degree
 156  0000                                              ; (182: 0.711 units, 8.8 fixed)
 157  0000              CLIMB_RATE      equ 4           ; units/frame: 0.31 m/frame, ~4.4 m/s
 158  0000              SPEED_STEP      equ 1           ; Q / A: speed change a frame, units/frame
 159  0000                                              ; (1.1 m/s; player.asm uses inc / dec)
 160  0000                      ASSERT SPEED_STEP == 1
 161  0000              ; Air brake (Z): the speed falls by twice the Q / A step every frame, to 0
 162  0000              AIRBRAKE_STEP   equ 2*SPEED_STEP    ; 2 units/frame (2.2 m/s)
 163  0000              ; Booster module (a salvage reward, fitted at once: boost_fitted).  The
 164  0000              ; boost control (K_BOOST, X) puts the speed straight to BOOST_SPEED, twice
 165  0000              ; SPEED_MAX, if going forwards at BOOST_MIN or more with fuel left; again,
 166  0000              ; or out of fuel, puts back the speed it had (boost_spd).  Q, A and Z don't
 167  0000              ; change the speed while boosting.  Each boosted frame burns 1 fuel

 174  0000              ; Pitch damper: with neither E nor D held, the nose eases back to level.
 175  0000              ; Every PDAMP_FRAMES frames the 8.8 pitch moves towards 0 by
 176  0000              ; max(PDAMP_MIN, |pitch| * PDAMP_K) in 1/256ths of a pitch unit.  With
 177  0000              ; PDAMP_K 0 that is a steady PDAMP_MIN a frame: half a pitch unit, half the
 178  0000              ; rate of the nose keys (1 unit a frame), however far it is from level.  (A
 179  0000              ; PDAMP_K above 0 adds a share of what is left, faster when far off: 43, as
 180  0000              ; it was, returned up to 4 units a frame from full pitch.)

 679  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 680  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 681  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 682  0000                      ENDM
 683  0000
 684  0000              ; A building's 8 corners (vtx, 16 bytes each; index = x + 2*z + 4*top) from
 685  0000              ; corner 0, component C (0 X, 2 Y, 4 Z) at a time: v1 = v0 + vx, v3 = v1 +
 686  0000              ; vz, v2 = v0 + vz (vx, vz: vecs0, its edge vectors), and each top corner
 687  0000              ; its bottom corner + vy (vy_vec, the vertical edge).  The sums the corners
 688  0000              ; share are made once, in registers (draw_bld, city.asm).
 689  0000                      MACRO VBOX C
 690  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 691  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)                 ; vx
 692  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)               ; vz
 693  0000 ~                    push hl
 694  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 695  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 696  0000 ~                    push hl
 697  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 698  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 699  0000 ~                    ld de,(vy_vec+C)                ; vy
 700  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 701  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7 = v3 + vy
 702  0000 ~                    pop hl
 703  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 704  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5 = v1 + vy
 705  0000 ~                    pop hl
 706  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 707  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 708  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 709  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6 = v2 + vy
 710  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)
 711  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 712  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0 + vy
 713  0000                      ENDM
 714  0000              ; The same for a component of vy that is 0 (X always; Z in level flight):
 715  0000              ; each top corner is its bottom corner
 716  0000                      MACRO VBOX0 C
 717  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 718  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0
 719  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)
 720  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)
 721  0000 ~                    push hl
 722  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 723  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 724  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5
 725  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 726  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 727  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7
 728  0000 ~                    pop hl
 729  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 730  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 731  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6
 732  0000                      ENDM
 733  0000
 734  0000              ; Copy cached screen corner of face vertex (HL)+ into p2buf (DE)+ with the
 735  0000              ; outline flag for edge bit EB taken from df_mask.  B = high vtx.
 736  0000                      MACRO FACEVTX EB
 737  0000 ~                    ld a,(hl)
 738  0000 ~                    inc hl
 739  0000 ~                    add a,7
 740  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 741  0000 ~                    ld a,(bc)
 742  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 743  0000 ~                    inc e
 744  0000 ~                    inc c
 745  0000 ~                    ld a,(bc)
 746  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 747  0000 ~                    inc e
 748  0000 ~                    ld a,(df_mask)
 749  0000 ~                    and EB
 750  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 751  0000 ~                    inc e
 752  0000 ~                    inc e
 753  0000                      ENDM

 756  0000              ; NEX entry: the loader leaves its default mapping (slot 6 = page 0, slot 5
 757  0000              ; = page 5), so the entry point is this stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000.  It maps
 758  0000              ; the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
 759  0000              ;==============================================================================
 760  0000                      MMU BOOT_SLOT e, PAGE_BOOT, BOOT_ADDR
 761  C000                      ORG BOOT_ADDR
 762  C000              boot:
 763  C000 F3                   di
 764  C001 31 1B C0             ld sp,boot_stack
 765  C004 ED 91 55 0B          nextreg MAIN_MMU,PAGE_MAIN
 766  C008 C3 13 A8             jp start
 767  C00B              boot_stack_bottom:
 768  C00B 00 00 00...              ds 16                       ; the loader's stack, until start
 769  C01B              boot_stack:
 770  C01B

 778  A057                      INCLUDE "levels.asm"            ; the current level's record
# file opened: levels.asm
   1+ A057              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A057              ; Z-POLICE - the current level's settings (resident, so any page can read
   3+ A057              ; them)
   4+ A057              ;
   5+ A057              ; level_cur holds the record of the level being played, loaded from its file
   6+ A057              ; ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL by load_level (level_load.asm).  LV_SIZE bytes:
   7+ A057              ;   +0  LV_NUM          level number
   8+ A057              ;   +1  LV_NAME         city name, 8 characters (ASCII, space padded)
   9+ A057              ;   +9  LV_ZOMBIES      number of zombies a wave (at most NZOMB)
  10+ A057              ;   +10 LV_WAVES        number of zombie waves (1..LV_MAX_WAVES)
  11+ A057              ;   +11 LV_FAST         number of fast zombies (of LV_ZOMBIES)
  12+ A057              ;   +12 LV_VIEW_R       draw distance in tiles, 2..VIEW_R (fewer: night or
  13+ A057              ;                       fog); load_level sets view_r / dot_r from it
  14+ A057              ;   +13 LV_WAVE_DATA    the special monsters of each wave, waves 1 to
  15+ A057              ;                       LV_MAX_WAVES (wave 1 is the level's start), LV_WAVE_REC
  16+ A057              ;                       bytes each:
  17+ A057              ;         +0  LV_SPECIAL_ID   LV_SPEC_SLOTS special types (SPEC_*;
  18+ A057              ;                             SPEC_NONE, 255: none in that place)
  19+ A057              ;         +5  LV_SPECIAL      how many of each (in the same places)
  20+ A057              ; The levels and their cities are made by gentables.py (ZPDATA/); a level
  21+ A057              ; file can be replaced by a hand-made one (or its text form, .TXL, edited).
  22+ A057              ;==============================================================================
  23+ A057
  24+ A057              LV_NUM          equ 0
  25+ A057              LV_NAME         equ 1
  26+ A057              LV_NAME_LEN     equ 8
  27+ A057              LV_ZOMBIES      equ LV_NAME+LV_NAME_LEN
  28+ A057              LV_WAVES        equ LV_ZOMBIES+1
  29+ A057              LV_FAST         equ LV_WAVES+1
  30+ A057              LV_VIEW_R       equ LV_FAST+1
  31+ A057              LV_WAVE_DATA    equ LV_VIEW_R+1
  32+ A057              LV_MAX_WAVES    equ 10              ; waves a level can have specials for
  33+ A057              LV_SPEC_SLOTS   equ 5               ; special types a wave
  34+ A057              LV_SPECIAL_ID   equ 0               ; (in a wave's data) the types,
  35+ A057              LV_SPECIAL      equ LV_SPEC_SLOTS   ;   then how many of each
  36+ A057              LV_WAVE_REC     equ 2*LV_SPEC_SLOTS
  37+ A057              LV_SIZE         equ LV_WAVE_DATA+LV_MAX_WAVES*LV_WAVE_REC   ; 113 bytes
  38+ A057                      ASSERT LV_SIZE == 113           ; (gentables.py writes it)
  39+ A057              ; Special monster types in the level files (specials.asm: spec_types)
  40+ A057              SPEC_GHOST      equ 0
  41+ A057              SPEC_BANSHEE    equ 1
  42+ A057              SPEC_GHOUL      equ 2
  43+ A057              SPEC_LICH       equ 3
  44+ A057              SPEC_IDS        equ 4               ; (how many types)
  45+ A057              SPEC_CLUSTER    equ 4               ; not a monster: the wave's zombies spawn in
  46+ A057                                                  ; this many clusters (zcluster, zombie.asm)
  47+ A057                      ASSERT SPEC_CLUSTER >= SPEC_IDS ; (spec_wave skips it)

 108+ A151              ; Carry clear if the raster is at line 192 or later (blanking).  The line is
 109+ A151              ; read as high byte ($1E), low byte ($1F), high byte again: if the high

 780  A375                      INCLUDE "sfx_data.asm"          ; the sound effects (sfx_tick plays them)
# file opened: sfx_data.asm
   1+ A375              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A375              ; Z-POLICE - sound effect data (resident: the main page, slot 5, always
   3+ A375              ; mapped, so the interrupt routine can read it whatever else is paged in)
   4+ A375              ;
   5+ A375              ; Played on AY 2 by sfx_tick (interrupts.asm); the game asks for one with
   6+ A375              ; ld a,SFX_n / ld (sfx_req),a (the numbers are in audio.asm).  A sound is a
   7+ A375              ; list of steps, one an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value
   8+ A375              ; pairs, ended by SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (over).
   9+ A375              ; The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is 109375/P Hz; a
  10+ A375              ; lower noise period is a brighter hiss.
  11+ A375              ;==============================================================================
  12+ A375
  13+ A375              ; One step of a zap: channel A at tone period p, channel B 2 periods flat
  14+ A375              ; (the two beat: a buzz), volumes v and v-2
  15+ A375                  MACRO SFX_ZAP p, v
  16+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_A, low (p), AY_TONE_A+1, high (p)
  17+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low ((p)+2), AY_TONE_B+1, high ((p)+2)
  18+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, v, AY_VOL_B, (v)-2, SFX_STEP
  19+ A375                  ENDM
  20+ A375
  21+ A375              ; One step of a woosh: channel A's noise at period n, volume v
  22+ A375                  MACRO SFX_WOOSH n, v
  23+ A375 ~                    db AY_NOISE, n, AY_VOL_A, v, SFX_STEP
  24+ A375                  ENDM
  25+ A375
  26+ A375              ; An explosion: a deep noise (channel A, darkening: period 16 up to 30) over
  27+ A375              ; a low rumble (channel B, BOOM_RUMBLE), both from volume peak (B 2 less)
  28+ A375              ; fading to nothing over len steps.  (A falling level is an exponential fade:
  29+ A375              ; the AY's levels are logarithmic.)
  30+ A375              BOOM_RUMBLE     equ 2735            ; 109375 / 2735 = 40 Hz
  31+ A375                  MACRO SFX_BOOM peak, len
  32+ A375 ~                    db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
  33+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
  34+ A375 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL 0
  35+ A375 ~                    DUP len
  36+ A375 ~                    db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(len)
  37+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, ((peak)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  38+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_B, (((peak)-2)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  39+ A375 ~                    db SFX_STEP
  40+ A375 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
  41+ A375 ~                    EDUP
  42+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  43+ A375                  ENDM
  44+ A375
  45+ A375              ; One step of a splat: channel C (only: see sfx_tick) at tone period p,
  46+ A375              ; volume v
  47+ A375                  MACRO SFX_SPLAT_STEP p, v
  48+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_C, low (p), AY_TONE_C+1, high (p), AY_VOL_C, v, SFX_STEP
  49+ A375                  ENDM
  50+ A375

 158+ A498              ; Explosions (rocket_blast, weapons.asm; on AY 3).  Each one's loudness in
 159+ A498              ; proportion to its blast's size, damage x reach (game units):
 160+ A498              ;   missile 15 x 256 = 3840, rocket 20 x 64 = 1280, autocannon 4 x 38 = 152,
 161+ A498              ;   proximity 3 x 25 = 75.
 162+ A498              ; Sound level is logarithmic (about 2 AY levels each doubling), so the peak
 163+ A498              ; is 15 + 2*log2(size / the missile's): 15, 12, 6, 4; and the bigger the
 164+ A498              ; blast the longer it rumbles, 2 steps (40 ms) per level: 600, 480, 240 and

 176+ A6CA
 177+ A6CA              ; The VTOL hitting a building (player.asm; on AY 3, as the explosions): a
 178+ A6CA              ; low crunch, like a missile's blast but deeper and shorter.  A cracking
 179+ A6CA              ; hit (brighter noise, full volume) drops at once into the deepest noise
 180+ A6CA              ; (period 31) over a lower rumble than the blasts' (about 27 Hz, channel B),
 181+ A6CA              ; fading over 260 ms.
 182+ A6CA              CRASH_RUMBLE    equ 4000            ; 109375 / 4000 = 27 Hz
 183+ A6CA                      ASSERT CRASH_RUMBLE < 4096
 184+ A6CA              CRASH_LEN       equ 10              ; the fade, steps
 185+ A6CA              ; The missile lock: two short high beeps (about 1.5 kHz, channel A), 80 ms
 186+ A6CA              ; each with 40 ms between
 187+ A6CA              LOCK_TONE       equ 73              ; tone period: 109375 / 73 = 1.5 kHz
 188+ A6CA              sfx_lock:
 189+ A6CA 07 3E                db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_TONE_A
 190+ A6CC 09 00 0A 00          db AY_VOL_B, 0, AY_VOL_C, 0
 191+ A6D0 00 49 01 00          db AY_TONE_A, low LOCK_TONE, AY_TONE_A+1, high LOCK_TONE
 192+ A6D4 08 0C FE FE          db AY_VOL_A, 12, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP
 192+ A6D8 FE FE
 193+ A6DA 08 00 FE FE          db AY_VOL_A, 0, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP
 194+ A6DE 08 0C FE FE          db AY_VOL_A, 12, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP
 194+ A6E2 FE FE
 195+ A6E4 08 00 FF             db AY_VOL_A, 0, SFX_END
 196+ A6E7

 200+ A6ED 06 0C 08 0F          db AY_NOISE, 12, AY_VOL_A, 15, AY_VOL_B, 13, SFX_STEP     ; the hit
 200+ A6F1 09 0D FE
 201+ A6F4 06 16 08 0F          db AY_NOISE, 22, AY_VOL_A, 15, AY_VOL_B, 14, SFX_STEP     ; the crunch
 201+ A6F8 09 0E FE
 202+ A6FB 06 1C 08 0E          db AY_NOISE, 28, AY_VOL_A, 14, AY_VOL_B, 13, SFX_STEP

  31+ A7EC              DMA_CONTINUOUS               equ $ad
  32+ A7EC              ZXN_DMA_PORT                 equ $6b
  33+ A7EC              ; DMA+ (zxnDDMA, core 3.03.00, port $6B only; REAL_HARDWARE builds)
  34+ A7EC              DDMA_MODE                    equ $df    ; then the flags: each sets them all
  35+ A7EC              DDMA_FILL_VALUE              equ $f7    ; then the value
  36+ A7EC              DDMA_FLAG_FILL               equ %00001000
  37+ A7EC
  38+ A7EC 00           l2_cls_byte	            DB 0
  39+ A7ED              ; ">DMA Command BLOCK"
  40+ A7ED
  41+ A7ED 83 C3 C7 CB  l2_fill                 DB DMA_DISABLE,  DMA_RESET, DMA_RESET_PORT_A_TIMING, DMA_RESET_PORT_B_TIMING
  42+ A7F1                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE
  43+ A7F1 ~                                    DB DDMA_FILL_VALUE      ; DMA+ fill: no reads, so twice
  44+ A7F1 ~            l2_fill_value           DB 0                    ; as fast as a fixed source
  45+ A7F1 ~                                    DB DDMA_MODE, DDMA_FLAG_FILL
  46+ A7F1                  ENDIF

  48+ A7F2 EC A7        l2_fill_astrt           DW l2_cls_byte
  49+ A7F4 00 C0        l2_fill_length          DB $00,$C0
  50+ A7F6 24 10 AD                             DB DMA_WR1_P1FIXED_MEMORY ,DMA_WR2_P2INC_MEMORY ,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE
  51+ A7F9 00 00        l2_fill_bstrt           DB $00,$00
  52+ A7FB 82 CF B3 87                          DB DMA_STOP_AT_END, DMA_LOAD, DMA_FORCE_READY, DMA_ENABLE
  53+ A7FF                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE
  54+ A7FF ~                                    DB DDMA_MODE, 0         ; the mode off again: fill_spans
  55+ A7FF                  ENDIF                                       ; and occ_dma are plain copies
  56+ A7FF              l2_fill_cmd_len	        EQU $ - l2_fill
  57+ A7FF
  58+ A7FF
  59+ A7FF              ; DMA fill: HL = destination, BC = length (non-zero), A = the byte.  Any
  60+ A7FF              ; memory mapped in now (the Layer 2 sections in slot 0, the occlusion page,
  61+ A7FF              ; the ULA screen).  Resident (the main page, with this block), so the city,
  62+ A7FF              ; HUD and menu pages all use it.  It leaves the length's high byte set:
  63+ A7FF              ; fill_spans needs it 0 (clear_screen.spans), so the city page restores it
  64+ A7FF              ; after a fill of its own.
  65+ A7FF              dma_fill:
  66+ A7FF 32 EC A7             ld (l2_cls_byte),a
  67+ A802                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE
  68+ A802 ~                    ld (l2_fill_value),a
  69+ A802                  ENDIF

  71+ A805 ED 43 F4 A7          ld (l2_fill_length),bc

  73+ A80C 06 12                ld b,l2_fill_cmd_len

 823  A869              ; clip window, palettes, memory map), which the menu leaves alone; here the

 915  A8E2              ; each level completed (level_complete_screen).  The VTOL goes back onto the base pad, level and

 952  A936 CD 41 E0             call engine_start               ; interrupt plays them)

 956  A943
 957  A943                      ; clear both buffers
 958  A943 ED 91 57 01          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY
 959  A947 3E 40                ld a,VIEW_CY
 960  A949 32 66 B6             ld (horizon),a
 961  A94C 3E 12                ld a,PAGE_L2_A
 962  A94E 32 8D B6             ld (seg_base),a
 963  A951 CD 5B F2             call clear_screen
 964  A954 3E 18                ld a,PAGE_L2_B

 967  A95C ED 91 12 09          nextreg $12,L2_BANK_A           ; Layer 2 active (displayed) bank
 968  A960 ED 91 13 0C          nextreg $13,L2_BANK_B           ; Layer 2 shadow bank (drawn into)
 969  A964 01 3B 12             ld bc,$123B
 970  A967 3E 02                ld a,%00000010                  ; Layer 2 visible (the menu hid it)

 978  A97F
 979  A97F              ;==============================================================================
 980  A97F              ; Main loop
 981  A97F              ;==============================================================================
 982  A97F              main_loop:
 983  A97F ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; input at $E000, while the logic runs
 984  A983 CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan                   ; all key and joystick banks
 985  A986 3E 12                ld a,K_PAUSE                    ; paused until the pause control is

1038  A9FF                  ENDIF

1041  AA05                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS

1043  AA05                  ENDIF

1045  AA09 CD DC E2             call hud_sprites                ; (hud_sprites.asm), with the new frame
1046  AA0C C3 7F A9             jp main_loop
1047  AA0F
1048  AA0F              ;==============================================================================
1049  AA0F              ; Frames per second, shown on the ULA layer above Layer 2.
1050  AA0F              ;
1051  AA0F              ; Interrupts stay off (the span filler borrows SP), so time is taken from the
1052  AA0F              ; raster: vtick reads the current video line and counts a new 50Hz video
1053  AA0F              ; frame whenever the line number has gone backwards.  It must be called at
1054  AA0F              ; least once per video frame (~560K T at 28MHz); the main loop and draw_cell
1055  AA0F              ; do that.  Every 50 video frames (1 second) the number of frames rendered
1056  AA0F              ; becomes the FPS figure.
1057  AA0F              ;==============================================================================
1058  AA0F                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1059  AA0F ~            vtick:
1060  AA0F ~                    ld bc,$243B
1061  AA0F ~                    ld a,$1E
1062  AA0F ~                    out (c),a
1063  AA0F ~                    inc b
1064  AA0F ~                    in d,(c)                        ; line MSB
1065  AA0F ~                    dec b
1066  AA0F ~                    ld a,$1F
1067  AA0F ~                    out (c),a
1068  AA0F ~                    inc b
1069  AA0F ~                    in e,(c)                        ; line LSB
1070  AA0F ~                    dec b
1071  AA0F ~                    ld a,$1E
1072  AA0F ~                    out (c),a
1073  AA0F ~                    inc b
1074  AA0F ~                    in a,(c)
1075  AA0F ~                    cp d
1076  AA0F ~                    jr nz,vtick                     ; MSB changed mid-read: try again
1077  AA0F ~                    and 1
1078  AA0F ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = video line 0..311
1079  AA0F ~                    ld hl,(fps_line)
1080  AA0F ~                    ld (fps_line),de
1081  AA0F ~                    or a
1082  AA0F ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; previous - current
1083  AA0F ~                    ret c
1084  AA0F ~                    ret z
1085  AA0F ~                    ld hl,fps_vframes               ; line went backwards: new frame
1086  AA0F ~                    inc (hl)
1087  AA0F ~                    ret
1088  AA0F ~
1089  AA0F ~            ; Once per rendered frame, after the flip
1090  AA0F ~            fps_tick:
1091  AA0F ~                    call vtick
1092  AA0F ~                    ld hl,fps_count
1093  AA0F ~                    inc (hl)
1094  AA0F ~                    ld a,(fps_vframes)
1095  AA0F ~                    cp 50
1096  AA0F ~                    ret c
1097  AA0F ~                    sub 50
1098  AA0F ~                    ld (fps_vframes),a
1099  AA0F ~                    ld a,(fps_count)
1100  AA0F ~                    ld (fps_value),a
1101  AA0F ~                    xor a
1102  AA0F ~                    ld (fps_count),a
1103  AA0F ~                    jp fps_draw                     ; HUD page (paged in by main_loop)
1104  AA0F                  ENDIF
1105  AA0F
1106  AA0F              ; A = NextReg number -> A = its value
1107  AA0F              read_nextreg:
1108  AA0F 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1109  AA12 ED 79                out (c),a
1110  AA14 04                   inc b
1111  AA15 ED 78                in a,(c)
1112  AA17 C9                   ret
1113  AA18
1114  AA18              ; Select the shadow Layer 2 buffer for drawing: remember the 8K page of its
1115  AA18              ; first row.  Sections are then paged in on demand by seg_map / line_seg.
1116  AA18              map_shadow:
1117  AA18 3E 13                ld a,$13
1118  AA1A CD 0F AA             call read_nextreg
1119  AA1D 87                   add a,a                         ; 16K bank -> 8K page
1120  AA1E 32 8D B6             ld (seg_base),a
1121  AA21 C9                   ret
1122  AA22
1123  AA22              ; Show the shadow buffer and make the old active buffer the new shadow
1124  AA22              l2_flip:
1125  AA22 3E 12                ld a,$12
1126  AA24 CD 0F AA             call read_nextreg
1127  AA27 5F                   ld e,a                          ; old active
1128  AA28 3E 13                ld a,$13
1129  AA2A CD 0F AA             call read_nextreg
1130  AA2D ED 92 12             nextreg $12,a                   ; shadow -> active
1131  AA30 7B                   ld a,e
1132  AA31 ED 92 13             nextreg $13,a                   ; old active -> shadow
1133  AA34 C9                   ret
1134  AA35
1135  AA35              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1136  AA35              ; Layer 2 writes go through MMU slot 0 ($0000-$1FFF) only.  Each 8K page of
1137  AA35              ; the buffer is a 32-row section, so row y is page seg_base + y/32 and its
1138  AA35              ; pixels are at (y & 31)*256 + x.  Sections are paged in as drawing reaches
1139  AA35              ; them.  Slots 4-5 keep the ULA screen.
1140  AA35              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1141  AA35
1142  AA35              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1143  AA35              ; Screen shake, when the VTOL hits a building (player.asm sets shake_t to
1144  AA35              ; SHAKE_LEN).  Each rendered frame, as it is shown, the Layer 2 view is
1145  AA35              ; offset by the next pair of shake_xy through the scroll registers, a pixel
1146  AA35              ; or two each way, dying away; the last pair (0, 0) puts it back.  Only
1147  AA35              ; Layer 2 moves: the HUD is on the ULA.  (X wraps at 256, Y at 192: -n is
1148  AA35              ; 256-n and 192-n.  An edge row or column of the view shows the far side's
1149  AA35              ; meanwhile.)
1150  AA35              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1151  AA35              SHAKE_LEN       equ 6               ; rendered frames (about half a second)
1152  AA35              shake_tick:
1153  AA35 3A 67 AA             ld a,(shake_t)
1154  AA38 B7                   or a
1155  AA39 C8                   ret z
1156  AA3A 3D                   dec a
1157  AA3B 32 67 AA             ld (shake_t),a
1158  AA3E 87                   add a,a
1159  AA3F 21 5B AA             ld hl,shake_xy
1160  AA42 ED 31                add hl,a
1161  AA44 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1162  AA45 ED 92 16             nextreg $16,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
1163  AA48 23                   inc hl
1164  AA49 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1165  AA4A ED 92 17             nextreg $17,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
1166  AA4D C9                   ret
1167  AA4E
1168  AA4E              ; Stop any shake: the view back in place
1169  AA4E              shake_off:
1170  AA4E AF                   xor a
1171  AA4F 32 67 AA             ld (shake_t),a
1172  AA52 ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0
1173  AA56 ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0
1174  AA5A C9                   ret
1175  AA5B
1176  AA5B              ; (x, y) pixels, used from the last pair back to the first
1177  AA5B 00 00 01 00  shake_xy:   db 0,0, 1,0, 256-1,192-1, 1,1, 256-2,192-1, 2,1
1177  AA5F FF BF 01 01
1177  AA63 FE BF 02 01
1178  AA67                      ASSERT $ - shake_xy == 2*SHAKE_LEN
1179  AA67 00           shake_t:    db 0                        ; frames of shake left (0: none)
1180  AA68 00           gfx_ok:     db 0                        ; 1: the figures' graphics are loaded
1181  AA69
1182  AA69              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1183  AA69              ; Wait until the raster is outside the display area (line >= 192)
1184  AA69              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1185  AA69              wait_vblank:
1186  AA69 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1187  AA6C 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
1188  AA6E ED 79                out (c),a
1189  AA70 04                   inc b
1190  AA71 ED 78                in a,(c)
1191  AA73 E6 01                and 1
1192  AA75 C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256
1193  AA76 05                   dec b
1194  AA77 3E 1F                ld a,$1F
1195  AA79 ED 79                out (c),a
1196  AA7B 04                   inc b
1197  AA7C ED 78                in a,(c)
1198  AA7E FE C0                cp 192
1199  AA80 38 E7                jr c,wait_vblank
1200  AA82 C9                   ret
1201  AA83
1202  AA83              ; HL -> map byte for the cell the camera is in
1203  AA83              cam_cell_ptr:
1204  AA83 3A 63 AF             ld a,(cam_z+2)
1205  AA86 6F                   ld l,a
1206  AA87 26 00                ld h,0
1207  AA89                      ROWOFS
1207  AA89 29          >        add hl,hl
1207  AA8A 29          >        add hl,hl
1207  AA8B 29          >        add hl,hl
1207  AA8C 29          >        add hl,hl
1207  AA8D 29          >        add hl,hl
1207  AA8E 29          >        add hl,hl
1208  AA8F 3A 60 AF             ld a,(cam_x+2)
1209  AA92 ED 31                add hl,a
1210  AA94 11 00 70             ld de,city_map
1211  AA97 19                   add hl,de
1212  AA98 C9                   ret
1213  AA99
1214  AA99              ; A = damage to the VTOL (a building crash, a ghost): its hit points
1215  AA99              ; (vtol_hp) fall by that, not below 0.  At 0 it is destroyed (vtol_dead): it
1216  AA99              ; spins down out of control (vtol_wreck, player.asm), then the game is over.
1217  AA99              vtol_damage:
1218  AA99 B7                   or a
1219  AA9A C8                   ret z
1220  AA9B 4F                   ld c,a
1221  AA9C 3A 7B AF             ld a,(vtol_hp)
1222  AA9F 91                   sub c
1223  AAA0 30 01                jr nc,.hp
1224  AAA2 AF                   xor a
1225  AAA3 32 7B AF     .hp:    ld (vtol_hp),a
1226  AAA6 C0                   ret nz
1227  AAA7 3E 01                ld a,1
1228  AAA9 32 7C AF             ld (vtol_dead),a
1229  AAAC C9                   ret
1230  AAAD
1231  AAAD              ; HL = the height the VTOL rests at: MIN_Y when its whole footprint is over
1232  AAAD              ; road, or just clear (COLL_H) of the highest roof under it
1233  AAAD              floor_y:
1234  AAAD CD 1A AD             call vtol_ground
1235  AAB0 21 08 00             ld hl,MIN_Y
1236  AAB3 C8                   ret z
1237  AAB4 2A 1A B0             ld hl,(vg_max)
1238  AAB7 11 0D 00             ld de,COLL_H+1
1239  AABA 19                   add hl,de
1240  AABB C9                   ret
1241  AABC
1242  AABC              ; Weapon type details, by WPN_*: its full load, reload frames a shot (0:
1243  AABC              ; doesn't reload; the AMMO_INF weapons) and the slots it may be fitted in
1244  AABC              ; (resident, for the weapons page and the load-out screen)
1245  AABC 00 00 1F     wpn_cfg:    db 0, 0, WS_ANY                             ; WPN_NONE (empty)
1246  AABF FF 00 01                 db AMMO_INF, 0, WS_CENTRE                   ; WPN_GUN
1247  AAC2 FF 00 01                 db AMMO_INF, 0, WS_CENTRE                   ; WPN_LASER
1248  AAC5 FF 00 01                 db AMMO_INF, 0, WS_CENTRE                   ; WPN_CHAIN
1249  AAC8 0C 0F 1E                 db ROCKET_SHOTS, ROCKET_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS   ; WPN_ROCKETS
1250  AACB 04 1E 1E                 db MISSILE_SHOTS, MISSILE_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS ; WPN_MISSILE
1251  AACE 01 1E 1E                 db BOMB_SHOTS, BOMB_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS       ; WPN_BOMB
1252  AAD1 32 07 1E                 db AUTOCANNON_SHOTS, AUTOCANNON_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS ; WPN_AUTOCANNON
1253  AAD4 32 07 1E                 db PROX_SHOTS, PROX_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS       ; WPN_PROX
1254  AAD7 C8 01 08                 db LINK_SHOTS, LINK_RELOAD, WS_LINK_L       ; WPN_LCHAIN_L
1255  AADA C8 01 10                 db LINK_SHOTS, LINK_RELOAD, WS_LINK_R       ; WPN_LCHAIN_R
1256  AADD                      ASSERT LINK_SHOTS < AMMO_INF
1257  AADD                      ASSERT WPN_ROCKETS == 4 && WPN_MISSILE == 5 && WPN_AUTOCANNON == 7
1258  AADD                      ASSERT WPN_PROX == 8 && WPN_LCHAIN_L == 9 && WPN_LCHAIN_R == 10
1259  AADD                      ASSERT $ - wpn_cfg == WCFG_SIZE*(WPN_LAST+1)
1260  AADD
1261  AADD              ; A = weapon type -> HL = its wpn_cfg entry.  Preserves BC, DE.
1262  AADD              wpn_cfg_ptr:
1263  AADD 6F                   ld l,a
1264  AADE 87                   add a,a
1265  AADF 85                   add a,l                         ; * WCFG_SIZE
1266  AAE0 21 BC AA             ld hl,wpn_cfg
1267  AAE3 ED 31                add hl,a
1268  AAE5 C9                   ret
1269  AAE6                      ASSERT WCFG_SIZE == 3
1270  AAE6
1271  AAE6              ; A = weapon type, C = slot (0 = the centre slot): carry set if the weapon
1272  AAE6              ; may be fitted in that slot (WCFG_SLOTS).  Preserves DE.
1273  AAE6              wpn_fits:
1274  AAE6 CD DD AA             call wpn_cfg_ptr
1275  AAE9 3E 02                ld a,WCFG_SLOTS
1276  AAEB ED 31                add hl,a
1277  AAED 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1278  AAEE 41                   ld b,c
1279  AAEF 04                   inc b
1280  AAF0 0F           .sh:    rrca                            ; bit C into carry
1281  AAF1 10 FD                djnz .sh
1282  AAF3 C9                   ret

1301  AB09
1302  AB09              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1303  AB09              ; Paused (main_loop: the pause control, K_PAUSE, BREAK or a Mega Drive pad's
1304  AB09              ; START by default): PAUSED over the view, white on an opaque black ULA box,
1305  AB09              ; and under it S: SAVE AND QUIT and X: QUIT, NO SAVE, until the pause control
1306  AB09              ; is pressed again.  Nothing moves meanwhile and the screen keeps its last
1307  AB09              ; frame.  S (fixed: only while paused) saves the game (save_game) and goes
1308  AB09              ; back to the main menu; if it can't be saved, SAVE FAILED, and it stays
1309  AB09              ; paused.  (Not in a wreck: nothing to save.)  X (fixed too) goes back to
1310  AB09              ; the main menu without saving: the game is lost, and any save game is left
1311  AB09              ; as it was.  Needs the input page in slot 7.
1312  AB09              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1313  AB09              PAUSE_ROW       equ 7               ; ULA character row and column of the box
1314  AB09              PAUSE_COL       equ 12
1315  AB09              PAUSE_ROW2      equ 9               ; and of the save line
1316  AB09              PAUSE_COL2      equ 7
1317  AB09              PAUSE_ROW3      equ 10              ; and of the quit line
1318  AB09              PAUSE_ATTR      equ 2<<3 | 7        ; paper 2 (opaque black), ink 7 (white)
1319  AB09              VIEW_ATTR       equ %01000111       ; the viewport's own (ula_init): transparent
1320  AB09              game_pause:
1321  AB09 21 94 AB             ld hl,txt_paused
1322  AB0C 11 0C 07             ld de,PAUSE_ROW<<8 | PAUSE_COL
1323  AB0F 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1324  AB11 CD FC A0             call menu_print
1325  AB14 21 DF AB             ld hl,txt_pause_quit
1326  AB17 11 07 0A             ld de,PAUSE_ROW3<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1327  AB1A 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1328  AB1C CD FC A0             call menu_print
1329  AB1F 3A 7C AF             ld a,(vtol_dead)
1330  AB22 B7                   or a
1331  AB23 20 0B                jr nz,.w                        ; (a wreck: no saving)
1332  AB25 21 A6 AB             ld hl,txt_pause_save
1333  AB28 11 07 09             ld de,PAUSE_ROW2<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1334  AB2B 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1335  AB2D CD FC A0             call menu_print
1336  AB30 CD 46 A1     .w:     call menu_frame
1337  AB33 CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan
1338  AB36 3A 7C AF             ld a,(vtol_dead)
1339  AB39 B7                   or a
1340  AB3A 20 08                jr nz,.np
1341  AB3C 21 02 01             ld hl,KB_S                      ; save and quit
1342  AB3F CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
1343  AB42 20 30                jr nz,.save
1344  AB44 21 04 00     .np:    ld hl,KB_X                      ; quit, no save
1345  AB47 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
1346  AB4A 20 2D                jr nz,.quit

1384  ABF2
1385  ABF2              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1386  ABF2              ; Save games: ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS (beside the level files), one game.  Written
1387  ABF2              ; by save and quit (game_pause: save_game), read by CONTINUE on the main menu
1388  ABF2              ; (load_save, continue_game).  "ZPSV", SG_VERSION, then the fields in
1389  ABF2              ; sg_fields, in order: the level and wave, the salvage, the VTOL's integrity
1390  ABF2              ; (vtol_hp), its weapon slots (type and ammo each) and the selected one, the
1391  ABF2              ; store (wpn_stock, wpn_unlocked), the booster (fitted, fuel), and the
1392  ABF2              ; vision modes (vision_owned), and the vertical and lateral thrusters
1393  ABF2              ; (vthrust_fitted, lthrust_fitted).  Files of an older version (1: before
1394  ABF2              ; the vision modes, 2: before the vertical thrusters, 3: before the lateral
1395  ABF2              ; ones, 4: before the linked chain guns, a longer store) are refused, as any
1396  ABF2              ; other version.
1397  ABF2              ; Continued, the level starts afresh at the saved wave: its zombies, the
1398  ABF2              ; humans (and this level's rescues so far) and the base are new.
1399  ABF2              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1400  ABF2              SG_VERSION      equ 5
1401  ABF2              sg_fields:      ; address, bytes
1402  ABF2 78 AF                dw level
1403  ABF4 01                   db 1
1404  ABF5 81 AF                dw wave_number
1405  ABF7 01                   db 1
1406  ABF8 83 AF                dw salvage_points
1407  ABFA 02                   db 2
1408  ABFB 7B AF                dw vtol_hp
1409  ABFD 01                   db 1
1410  ABFE 6B AF                dw wpn_slots
1411  AC00 0A                   db WPN_SLOTS*2
1412  AC01 75 AF                dw wpn_sel
1413  AC03 01                   db 1
1414  AC04 EF AF                dw wpn_stock
1415  AC06 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
1416  AC07 FA AF                dw wpn_unlocked
1417  AC09 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
1418  AC0A 0A B0                dw boost_fitted                 ; (and boost_fuel, after it)
1419  AC0C 02                   db 2
1420  AC0D 05 B0                dw vision_owned
1421  AC0F 01                   db 1
1422  AC10 06 B0                dw vthrust_fitted
1423  AC12 01                   db 1
1424  AC13 07 B0                dw lthrust_fitted
1425  AC15 01                   db 1
1426  AC16 00 00                dw 0                            ; (the end)
1427  AC18                      ASSERT boost_fuel == boost_fitted+1
1428  AC18              SG_SIZE         equ 5+1+1+2+1+WPN_SLOTS*2+1+2*(WPN_LAST+1)+2+1+1+1
1429  AC18
1430  AC18              ; Copy the fields: A = 0 the game's into sg_buf, 1 sg_buf's into the game
1431  AC18              sg_copy:
1432  AC18 32 D3 AC             ld (sg_dir),a
1433  AC1B DD 21 F2 AB          ld ix,sg_fields
1434  AC1F 11 DA AC             ld de,sg_buf+5
1435  AC22 DD 6E 00     .lp:    ld l,(ix+0)
1436  AC25 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1437  AC28 7C                   ld a,h
1438  AC29 B5                   or l
1439  AC2A C8                   ret z
1440  AC2B DD 4E 02             ld c,(ix+2)
1441  AC2E 06 00                ld b,0
1442  AC30 3A D3 AC             ld a,(sg_dir)
1443  AC33 B7                   or a
1444  AC34 28 06                jr z,.out
1445  AC36 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; into the game: HL = sg_buf
1446  AC37 ED B0                ldir
1447  AC39 EB                   ex de,hl
1448  AC3A 18 02                jr .nx
1449  AC3C ED B0        .out:   ldir                            ; out of it: HL = the field
1450  AC3E 01 03 00     .nx:    ld bc,3
1451  AC41 DD 09                add ix,bc
1452  AC43 18 DD                jr .lp
1453  AC45
1454  AC45              ; Save the game.  Carry set (A = the esxDOS error) if it couldn't be
1455  AC45              ; written.  Leaves the file handler in slot 7.

1469  AC64 C3 90 E0             jp fh_save
1470  AC67
1471  AC67              ; Read the save game into sg_buf: carry set if there's none, or it isn't a
1472  AC67              ; save game this version can use (its level out of range too).  Leaves the
1473  AC67              ; file handler in slot 7.

1475  AC67 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE

1482  AC7B 09                   add hl,bc

1484  AC7D B5                   or l
1485  AC7E 20 21                jr nz,.bad
1486  AC80 21 D5 AC             ld hl,sg_buf
1487  AC83 11 CF AC             ld de,sg_magic
1488  AC86 06 04                ld b,4
1489  AC88 1A           .m:     ld a,(de)
1490  AC89 BE                   cp (hl)
1491  AC8A 20 15                jr nz,.bad

1493  AC8D 13                   inc de

1497  AC93 20 0C                jr nz,.bad

1499  AC98 B7                   or a
1500  AC99 28 06                jr z,.bad
1501  AC9B FE 33                cp LEVEL_LAST+1
1502  AC9D 30 02                jr nc,.bad
1503  AC9F B7                   or a                            ; usable: carry clear
1504  ACA0 C9                   ret
1505  ACA1 37           .bad:   scf
1506  ACA2 C9                   ret
1507  ACA3
1508  ACA3              ; CONTINUE (main menu, after load_save): a new game with the save game's
1509  ACA3              ; fields over it, into its level at its wave

1528  AD05
1529  AD05              ; Z if the VTOL is landed: speed 0 and resting on the floor under it (the
1530  AD05              ; road, the landing pad or a roof: floor_y), and not a wreck.  Landed, its
1531  AD05              ; weapons don't fire (update_weapons) and humans can board or get off
1532  AD05              ; (human_update).

1550  AD1A
1551  AD1A              ; The VTOL's footprint: the corners and the long-side midpoints of its
1552  AD1A              ; VTOL_HL x VTOL_HW (half size) rectangle, turned to the heading, round
1553  AD1A              ; (cam_x, cam_z).  The rectangle is smaller than a tile, so these six points
1554  AD1A              ; find every cell it overlaps (to within a tile corner nicking a long side).
1555  AD1A              ; HL = vg_max = the highest ground under them; Z if all road (0).
1556  AD1A              vtol_ground:

1811  AF25              ; fmul: HL = HL * DE >> 8
1812  AF25              ;   HL = signed 16-bit integer, DE = S7.8 factor in -1.0..+1.0
1813  AF25              ;   Sign/magnitude using two 8x8 MUL D,E.  Preserves IX, IY.
1814  AF25              fmul:
1815  AF25 7C                   ld a,h
1816  AF26 AA                   xor d
1817  AF27 F5                   push af                         ; result sign in bit 7
1818  AF28 CB 7C                bit 7,h

1841  AF45 54                   ld d,h

1843  AF47 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; hi * f

1847  AF4C 7A                   ld a,d

1852  AF52 AF                   xor a

1856  AF56 94                   sub h

  61+ E100              ; Unrolled span writer: entry = push_end - 1 - pairs (pairs 1..128).  SP is
  62+ E100              ; borrowed (it points into the span), so an interrupt pushes its return

 204+ E90B              ; E = A / C, A = A mod C  (8-bit unsigned, C 1..127).  By reciprocal:
 205+ E90B              ; q = (A * R) >> 16, R = rcp8[C] = ceil(65536 / C), exact for every A

 248+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 249+ E937              ; Perspective projection
 250+ E937              ;   in : HL -> X,Y,Z (camera space, inside the view frustum, Z > 0)
 251+ E937              ;   out: A = screen x (0..255), C = screen y (0..VIEW_H-1)
 252+ E937              ;   sx = 128 + 128*X/Z,  sy = 64 - 128*Y/Z   (90 x 53 degree field of view)
 253+ E937              ;   Z is normalised to 9 bits (256..511) with a barrel shift (count from a
 254+ E937              ;   log2 table) that is also applied to X and Y, which are then multiplied
