 536+ EAFB              ; plane's c2_or bit (the upper's is the next) -> HL = DE + 128 HL / Z (the
 537+ EAFB              ; Z patched in by zpatch), and the plane it is outside, if any, into c2_or
 538+ EAFB              c2_scr:
 539+ EAFB C5                   push bc
 540+ EAFC D5                   push de
 541+ EAFD 7C                   ld a,h
 542+ EAFE F5                   push af
 543+ EAFF CD 20 EB             call scomp16
 544+ EB02 F1                   pop af
 545+ EB03 17                   rla
 546+ EB04 DC 19 AF             call c,neg_hl
 547+ EB07 D1                   pop de
 548+ EB08 19                   add hl,de
 549+ EB09 C1                   pop bc
 550+ EB0A 7C                   ld a,h
 551+ EB0B B7                   or a
 552+ EB0C 28 05                jr z,.z
 553+ EB0E FA 18 EB             jp m,.lo                        ; < 0
 554+ EB11 18 03                jr .hi                          ; > 255
 555+ EB13 78           .z:     ld a,b
 556+ EB14 BD                   cp l
 557+ EB15 D0                   ret nc                          ; inside
 558+ EB16 CB 21        .hi:    sla c
 559+ EB18 3A DB E0     .lo:    ld a,(c2_or)
 560+ EB1B B1                   or c
 561+ EB1C 32 DB E0             ld (c2_or),a
 562+ EB1F C9                   ret
 563+ EB20
 564+ EB20              ; HL = signed component -> HL = round(|HL| * 128 / Z), |HL| <= 2Z: as
 565+ EB20              ; scale_comp (the same shift and reciprocal, patched into it by zpatch),
 566+ EB20              ; with a 10-bit Xn and a 16-bit result
 567+ EB20              scomp16:
 568+ EB20 CD 20 AF             call abs_hl
 569+ EB23 EB                   ex de,hl
 570+ EB24 3A F2 EB             ld a,(scale_comp.sh+1)          ; the shift zpatch set: its count,
 571+ EB27 47                   ld b,a
 572+ EB28 3A F4 EB             ld a,(scale_comp.op+1)          ; and which way (its opcode)
 573+ EB2B FE 28                cp OP_BSLA
 574+ EB2D 28 04                jr z,.l
 575+ EB2F ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 576+ EB31 18 02                jr .s
 577+ EB33 ED 28        .l:     bsla de,b
 578+ EB35 EB           .s:     ex de,hl
 579+ EB36 7C                   ld a,h
 580+ EB37 FE 04                cp 4
 581+ EB39 38 03                jr c,.ok
 582+ EB3B 21 FF 03             ld hl,1023                      ; (rounding at the guard band's edge)
 583+ EB3E 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bits 8-9 of Xn
 584+ EB3F 3A FE EB             ld a,(scale_comp.rl+1)
 585+ EB42 5F                   ld e,a
 586+ EB43 55                   ld d,l
 587+ EB44 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 588+ EB46 4A                   ld c,d
 589+ EB47 3A 04 EC             ld a,(scale_comp.rh+1)
 590+ EB4A 5F                   ld e,a
 591+ EB4B 55                   ld d,l
 592+ EB4C ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 593+ EB4E 79                   ld a,c
 594+ EB4F 83                   add a,e
 595+ EB50 6F                   ld l,a
 596+ EB51 7A                   ld a,d
 597+ EB52 CE 00                adc a,0
 598+ EB54 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 599+ EB55 0E 00                ld c,0
 600+ EB57 78                   ld a,b
 601+ EB58 B7                   or a
 602+ EB59 28 0A                jr z,.nh
 603+ EB5B ED 5B 14 EC          ld de,(scale_comp.r16+1)
 604+ EB5F 19           .ad:    add hl,de                       ; + (256 * Xh * R) >> 8
 605+ EB60 30 01                jr nc,.a1
 606+ EB62 0C                   inc c
 607+ EB63 10 FA        .a1:    djnz .ad
 608+ EB65 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)
 609+ EB66 20 01                jr nz,.nr
 610+ EB68 0C                   inc c
 611+ EB69 6C           .nr:    ld l,h
 612+ EB6A 61                   ld h,c
 613+ EB6B CB 3C                srl h
 614+ EB6D CB 1D                rr l                            ; HL = (C:H) >> 1 = P >> 9
 615+ EB6F C9                   ret
 616+ EB70
 617+ EB70              ; clip_isect for a 2D plane: the point where the edge S-E crosses it, out
 618+ EB70              ; at IY (IY and clip_on advanced).  Worked out from the edge's inside end,
 619+ EB70              ; so an edge two faces share is cut at the same point whichever way it
 620+ EB70              ; runs: t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|), the other coordinate o_in + t (o_out -
 621+ EB70              ; o_in), this one exactly on the bound.
 622+ EB70              c2_isect:
 623+ EB70 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
 624+ EB73 ED 5B D0 E0          ld de,(clip_e)
 625+ EB77 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 626+ EB7A 17                   rla
 627+ EB7B 30 01                jr nc,.sin
 628+ EB7D EB                   ex de,hl                        ; S outside: E is the inside end
 629+ EB7E 3A DC E0     .sin:   ld a,(c2_off)
 630+ EB81 EE 02                xor 2                           ; the other coordinate
 631+ EB83 ED 31                add hl,a
 632+ EB85 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 633+ EB86 23                   inc hl
 634+ EB87 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; o_in
 635+ EB88 EB                   ex de,hl
 636+ EB89 ED 31                add hl,a
 637+ EB8B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 638+ EB8C 23                   inc hl
 639+ EB8D 66                   ld h,(hl)
 640+ EB8E 6F                   ld l,a                          ; o_out
 641+ EB8F B7                   or a
 642+ EB90 ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; o_out - o_in
 643+ EB92 28 26                jr z,.same                      ; (a vertical / horizontal edge: o_in)
 644+ EB94 C5                   push bc
 645+ EB95 E5                   push hl
 646+ EB96 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 647+ EB99 CD 20 AF             call abs_hl
 648+ EB9C EB                   ex de,hl
 649+ EB9D 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 650+ EBA0 CD 20 AF             call abs_hl
 651+ EBA3 19                   add hl,de
 652+ EBA4 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |dS| + |dE|
 653+ EBA5 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 654+ EBA8 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 655+ EBAA 28 03                jr z,.di
 656+ EBAC 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 657+ EBAF CD 83 E8     .di:    call div_frac                   ; t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|)
 658+ EBB2 E1                   pop hl                          ; o_out - o_in
 659+ EBB3 DD E5                push ix
 660+ EBB5 D1                   pop de
 661+ EBB6 CD 50 E8             call mul_frac
 662+ EBB9 C1                   pop bc
 663+ EBBA 09           .same:  add hl,bc                       ; o_in + t (o_out - o_in)
 664+ EBBB 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 665+ EBBE B7                   or a
 666+ EBBF 20 12                jr nz,.y
 667+ EBC1 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l                     ; an x plane: y worked out
 668+ EBC4 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
 669+ EBC7 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 670+ EBCA FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 671+ EBCD FD 36 01 00          ld (iy+1),0
 672+ EBD1 18 10                jr .f
 673+ EBD3 FD 75 00     .y:     ld (iy+0),l                     ; a y plane: x worked out
 674+ EBD6 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
 675+ EBD9 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 676+ EBDC FD 77 02             ld (iy+2),a
 677+ EBDF FD 36 03 00          ld (iy+3),0
 678+ EBE3 C3 50 EE     .f:     jp clip_isect.nz                ; its edge flag, IY and clip_on on
 679+ EBE6                  ENDIF
 680+ EBE6
 681+ EBE6              ; HL = signed component -> A = round(|HL| * 128 / Z)
 682+ EBE6              ; The shift and reciprocal for this Z are patched in by zpatch: the shift
 683+ EBE6              ; as a barrel shift whose count and direction (its opcode, BSRL or BSLA)
 684+ EBE6              ; are both patched, so it runs straight through (a right shift by 0 for a Z
 685+ EBE6              ; already 256..511 leaves it as it is).
 686+ EBE6              scale_comp:
 687+ EBE6 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 688+ EBE8 28 06                jr z,.ap
 689+ EBEA AF                   xor a
 690+ EBEB 95                   sub l
 691+ EBEC 6F                   ld l,a
 692+ EBED 9F                   sbc a,a
 693+ EBEE 94                   sub h
 694+ EBEF 67                   ld h,a
 695+ EBF0 EB           .ap:    ex de,hl
 696+ EBF1 06 00        .sh:    ld b,0                          ; (zpatch: the count)
 697+ EBF3 ED 2A        .op:    bsrl de,b                       ; (zpatch: bsrl, or bsla)
 698+ EBF5 EB                   ex de,hl
 699+ EBF6                      ASSERT {b scale_comp.op} == $ED && {b scale_comp.op+1} == OP_BSRL
 700+ EBF6 7C           .sd:    ld a,h
 701+ EBF7 FE 02                cp 2
 702+ EBF9 30 27                jr nc,.big
 703+ EBFB 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bit 8 of Xn
 704+ EBFC 55                   ld d,l
 705+ EBFD 1E 00        .rl:    ld e,0
 706+ EBFF ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 707+ EC01 4A                   ld c,d
 708+ EC02 55                   ld d,l
 709+ EC03 1E 00        .rh:    ld e,0
 710+ EC05 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 711+ EC07 79                   ld a,c
 712+ EC08 83                   add a,e
 713+ EC09 6F                   ld l,a
 714+ EC0A 7A                   ld a,d
 715+ EC0B CE 00                adc a,0
 716+ EC0D 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 717+ EC0E 0E 00                ld c,0
 718+ EC10 05                   dec b
 719+ EC11 20 06                jr nz,.nh
 720+ EC13 11 00 00     .r16:   ld de,0
 721+ EC16 19                   add hl,de                       ; + (256*R) >> 8
 722+ EC17 CB 11                rl c
 723+ EC19 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)
 724+ EC1A 20 01                jr nz,.nr
 725+ EC1C 0C                   inc c
 726+ EC1D 79           .nr:    ld a,c
 727+ EC1E 1F                   rra
 728+ EC1F 7C                   ld a,h
 729+ EC20 1F                   rra                             ; A = (C:H) >> 1  = P >> 9
 730+ EC21 C9                   ret
 731+ EC22 21 FF 01     .big:   ld hl,511                       ; clamp (rounding at frustum edge)
 732+ EC25 18 D4                jr .ok
 733+ EC27
 734+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 735+ EC27              ; Outcode: HL -> vertex (X,Y,Z) -> A = bits
 736+ EC27              ;   1 near (Z<NEAR)  2 left (X<-Z)  4 right (X>Z)
 737+ EC27              ;   8 top (Y>0.5Z)   16 bottom (Y<-0.5Z)
 738+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 739+ EC27              calc_oc:
 740+ EC27 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 741+ EC28 23                   inc hl
 742+ EC29 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE = X
 743+ EC2A 23                   inc hl
 744+ EC2B 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 745+ EC2C 23                   inc hl
 746+ EC2D 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; BC = Y
 747+ EC2E 23                   inc hl
 748+ EC2F 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 749+ EC30 23                   inc hl
 750+ EC31 66                   ld h,(hl)
 751+ EC32 6F                   ld l,a                          ; HL = Z
 752+ EC33 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 753+ EC35 20 0D                jr nz,.nr
 754+ EC37 7C                   ld a,h
 755+ EC38 B7                   or a
 756+ EC39 3E 00                ld a,0
 757+ EC3B 20 09                jr nz,.n1
 758+ EC3D 7D                   ld a,l
 759+ EC3E FE 10                cp NEAR
 760+ EC40 3E 00                ld a,0
 761+ EC42 30 02                jr nc,.n1
 762+ EC44 3E 01        .nr:    ld a,1
 763+ EC46 E5           .n1:    push hl
 764+ EC47 19                   add hl,de                       ; Z+X
 765+ EC48 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 766+ EC4A 28 02                jr z,.n2
 767+ EC4C F6 02                or 2
 768+ EC4E E1           .n2:    pop hl
 769+ EC4F E5                   push hl
 770+ EC50 B7                   or a
 771+ EC51 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; Z-X
 772+ EC53 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 773+ EC55 28 02                jr z,.n3
 774+ EC57 F6 04                or 4
 775+ EC59 E1           .n3:    pop hl
 776+ EC5A CB 2C                sra h
 777+ EC5C CB 1D                rr l                            ; 0.5Z
 778+ EC5E E5                   push hl
 779+ EC5F B7                   or a
 780+ EC60 ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; 0.5Z-Y
 781+ EC62 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 782+ EC64 28 02                jr z,.n4
 783+ EC66 F6 08                or 8
 784+ EC68 E1           .n4:    pop hl
 785+ EC69 09                   add hl,bc                       ; 0.5Z+Y
 786+ EC6A CB 7C                bit 7,h
 787+ EC6C C8                   ret z
 788+ EC6D F6 10                or 16
 789+ EC6F C9                   ret
 790+ EC70
 791+ EC70                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 792+ EC70              ; plane_dist for a 2D plane (clip2d): IX -> 2D vertex -> HL = its distance
 793+ EC70              ; inside c2_off / c2_hi (>= 0: inside)
 794+ EC70              c2_dist:
 795+ EC70 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 796+ EC73 DD E5                push ix
 797+ EC75 E1                   pop hl
 798+ EC76 ED 31                add hl,a
 799+ EC78 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 800+ EC79 23                   inc hl
 801+ EC7A 66                   ld h,(hl)
 802+ EC7B 6F                   ld l,a
 803+ EC7C 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 804+ EC7F B7                   or a
 805+ EC80 C8                   ret z                           ; v >= 0: v
 806+ EC81 EB                   ex de,hl
 807+ EC82 6F                   ld l,a
 808+ EC83 26 00                ld h,0
 809+ EC85 B7                   or a
 810+ EC86 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; v <= bound: bound - v
 811+ EC88 C9                   ret
 812+ EC89                  ENDIF
 813+ EC89
 814+ EC89              ; Signed distance of vertex IX to clip plane (clip_plane bit). >= 0 is inside.
 815+ EC89              plane_dist:
 816+ EC89                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 817+ EC89 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 818+ EC8C 17                   rla
 819+ EC8D 38 E1                jr c,c2_dist                    ; (bit 7: a 2D plane)
 820+ EC8F                  ENDIF
 821+ EC8F DD 6E 04             ld l,(ix+4)
 822+ EC92 DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)
 823+ EC95 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 824+ EC98 FE 01                cp 1
 825+ EC9A 20 05                jr nz,.p2
 826+ EC9C 11 F0 FF             ld de,-NEAR
 827+ EC9F 19                   add hl,de
 828+ ECA0 C9                   ret
 829+ ECA1 DD 5E 00     .p2:    ld e,(ix+0)
 830+ ECA4 DD 56 01             ld d,(ix+1)
 831+ ECA7 FE 02                cp 2
 832+ ECA9 20 02                jr nz,.p3
 833+ ECAB 19                   add hl,de
 834+ ECAC C9                   ret
 835+ ECAD FE 04        .p3:    cp 4
 836+ ECAF 20 04                jr nz,.p4
 837+ ECB1 B7                   or a
 838+ ECB2 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 839+ ECB4 C9                   ret
 840+ ECB5 F5           .p4:    push af
 841+ ECB6 CD 59 AF             call zhalf
 842+ ECB9 F1                   pop af
 843+ ECBA DD 5E 02             ld e,(ix+2)
 844+ ECBD DD 56 03             ld d,(ix+3)
 845+ ECC0 FE 08                cp 8
 846+ ECC2 20 04                jr nz,.p5
 847+ ECC4 B7                   or a
 848+ ECC5 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 849+ ECC7 C9                   ret
 850+ ECC8 19           .p5:    add hl,de
 851+ ECC9 C9                   ret
 852+ ECCA
 853+ ECCA              ;==============================================================================
 854+ ECCA              ; Sutherland-Hodgman clip of clip_src (clip_n verts) against clip_plane into
 855+ ECCA              ; clip_dst.  Vertex = X,Y,Z,flag,corner (8 bytes).  flag=1 means the edge from
 856+ ECCA              ; this vertex to the next is a real building edge (gets outlined); edges
 857+ ECCA              ; created along a clip plane get flag=0 so the screen border isn't outlined.
 858+ ECCA              ; corner = vtx offset of an unclipped building corner that is on screen, so
 859+ ECCA              ; its cached projection can be reused; $80 + plane bit for a vertex the
 860+ ECCA              ; clipper put on that plane; $FF for any other vertex.
 861+ ECCA              ;==============================================================================
 862+ ECCA              clip_poly:
 863+ ECCA 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 864+ ECCD 3D                   dec a
 865+ ECCE 87                   add a,a
 866+ ECCF 87                   add a,a
 867+ ECD0 87                   add a,a
 868+ ECD1 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)
 869+ ECD4 ED 31                add hl,a
 870+ ECD6 22 CE E0             ld (clip_s),hl
 871+ ECD9 E5                   push hl
 872+ ECDA DD E1                pop ix
 873+ ECDC CD 89 EC             call plane_dist
 874+ ECDF 22 D2 E0             ld (clip_ds),hl
 875+ ECE2 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)
 876+ ECE5 22 D0 E0             ld (clip_e),hl
 877+ ECE8 FD 2A CC E0          ld iy,(clip_dst)
 878+ ECEC AF                   xor a
 879+ ECED 32 C7 E0             ld (clip_on),a
 880+ ECF0 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 881+ ECF3 32 C8 E0             ld (clip_cnt),a
 882+ ECF6 DD 2A D0 E0  .loop:  ld ix,(clip_e)
 883+ ECFA CD 89 EC             call plane_dist
 884+ ECFD 22 D4 E0             ld (clip_de),hl
 885+ ED00 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 886+ ED02 20 33                jr nz,.eout
 887+ ED04 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 888+ ED07 CB 7F                bit 7,a
 889+ ED09 28 0D                jr z,.ein
 890+ ED0B                      ; S out, E in: intersection carries S's edge flag
 891+ ED0B DD 2A CE E0          ld ix,(clip_s)
 892+ ED0F DD 7E 06             ld a,(ix+6)
 893+ ED12 32 D6 E0             ld (clip_if),a
 894+ ED15 CD 73 ED             call clip_isect
 895+ ED18 2A D0 E0     .ein:   ld hl,(clip_e)                  ; whole vertex, with its corner byte
 896+ ED1B FD E5                push iy                         ; (LDI: 16 T a byte)
 897+ ED1D D1                   pop de
 898+ ED1E                      REPT 8
 899+ ED1E ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED20 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED22 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED24 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED26 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED28 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED2A ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED2C ED A0       >        ldi
 900+ ED2E                      ENDR
 901+ ED2E D5                   push de
 902+ ED2F FD E1                pop iy
 903+ ED31 21 C7 E0             ld hl,clip_on
 904+ ED34 34                   inc (hl)
 905+ ED35 18 0E                jr .next
 906+ ED37 3A D3 E0     .eout:  ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 907+ ED3A CB 7F                bit 7,a
 908+ ED3C 20 07                jr nz,.next
 909+ ED3E                      ; S in, E out: intersection starts a clip-plane edge
 910+ ED3E AF                   xor a
 911+ ED3F 32 D6 E0             ld (clip_if),a
 912+ ED42 CD 73 ED             call clip_isect
 913+ ED45 2A D0 E0     .next:  ld hl,(clip_e)
 914+ ED48 22 CE E0             ld (clip_s),hl
 915+ ED4B 11 08 00             ld de,8
 916+ ED4E 19                   add hl,de
 917+ ED4F 22 D0 E0             ld (clip_e),hl
 918+ ED52 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 919+ ED55 22 D2 E0             ld (clip_ds),hl
 920+ ED58 21 C8 E0             ld hl,clip_cnt
 921+ ED5B 35                   dec (hl)
 922+ ED5C 20 98                jr nz,.loop
 923+ ED5E 3A C7 E0             ld a,(clip_on)
 924+ ED61 32 C6 E0             ld (clip_n),a
 925+ ED64 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)                ; the output is the next pass's input
 926+ ED67 ED 5B CC E0          ld de,(clip_dst)
 927+ ED6B ED 53 CA E0          ld (clip_src),de
 928+ ED6F 22 CC E0             ld (clip_dst),hl
 929+ ED72 C9                   ret
 930+ ED73
 931+ ED73              ; Output S + t*(E-S) at IY, t = dS/(dS-dE)
 932+ ED73              clip_isect:
 933+ ED73                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 934+ ED73 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 935+ ED76 17                   rla
 936+ ED77 DA 70 EB             jp c,c2_isect                   ; (bit 7: a 2D plane)
 937+ ED7A                  ENDIF
 938+ ED7A                  IFDEF LEVEL_FAST_PATH
 939+ ED7A                      ; Level flight: a vertical building edge (S and E share X and Z)
 940+ ED7A                      ; meets the top or bottom plane at (X, +-0.5Z, Z) - no divide or
 941+ ED7A                      ; interpolation.  At pitch 0 vertical edges can't cross the near or
 942+ ED7A                      ; side planes, so this covers every plane they do cross.
 943+ ED7A 3A 69 AF             ld a,(pitch)
 944+ ED7D B7                   or a
 945+ ED7E 20 49                jr nz,.gen
 946+ ED80 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 947+ ED83 FE 08                cp 8
 948+ ED85 38 42                jr c,.gen                       ; not top or bottom
 949+ ED87 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
 950+ ED8A ED 5B D0 E0          ld de,(clip_e)
 951+ ED8E 1A                   ld a,(de)
 952+ ED8F BE                   cp (hl)
 953+ ED90 20 37                jr nz,.gen
 954+ ED92 23                   inc hl
 955+ ED93 13                   inc de
 956+ ED94 1A                   ld a,(de)
 957+ ED95 BE                   cp (hl)
 958+ ED96 20 31                jr nz,.gen                      ; X differs
 959+ ED98 23                   inc hl
 960+ ED99 23                   inc hl
 961+ ED9A 23                   inc hl
 962+ ED9B 13                   inc de
 963+ ED9C 13                   inc de
 964+ ED9D 13                   inc de
 965+ ED9E 1A                   ld a,(de)
 966+ ED9F BE                   cp (hl)
 967+ EDA0 20 27                jr nz,.gen
 968+ EDA2 23                   inc hl
 969+ EDA3 13                   inc de
 970+ EDA4 1A                   ld a,(de)
 971+ EDA5 BE                   cp (hl)
 972+ EDA6 20 21                jr nz,.gen                      ; Z differs
 973+ EDA8 DD 2A CE E0          ld ix,(clip_s)
 974+ EDAC DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+0)                     ; X and Z from S (= E)
 975+ EDAF FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 976+ EDB2 DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+1)
 977+ EDB5 FD 77 01             ld (iy+1),a
 978+ EDB8 DD 6E 04             ld l,(ix+4)
 979+ EDBB DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)
 980+ EDBE FD 75 04             ld (iy+4),l
 981+ EDC1 FD 74 05             ld (iy+5),h
 982+ EDC4 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 983+ EDC7 18 6D                jr .ty                          ; Y = +-0.5Z
 984+ EDC9              .gen:
 985+ EDC9                  ENDIF
 986+ EDC9 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 987+ EDCC CD 20 AF             call abs_hl
 988+ EDCF 22 D7 E0             ld (ci_a),hl
 989+ EDD2 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)

1277+ F049              ;==============================================================================
1278+ F049              ; Convex polygon fill from p2buf (8-bit screen coords).
1279+ F049              ;   Each edge is walked with an exact integer DDA into one of two x tables:
1280+ F049              ;   downward edges -> TA, upward edges -> TB.  For a convex polygon every row
1281+ F049              ;   then has one entry in each, and the span between them is filled.
1282+ F049              ;   Winding doesn't matter.
1283+ F049              ;==============================================================================

1351+ F0BC              ; Walk an edge (D=xa, E=ya) -> (B=xb, C=yb), yb > ya, into table page A.
1352+ F0BC              ; Bresenham style: x += q each row, fractional r/dy accumulated in a biased
1353+ F0BC              ; byte (carry == wrap), so the end point is hit exactly.
1354+ F0BC              walk_edge:

1360+ F0C1 78                   ld a,b

1374+ F0DD B7                   or a
1375+ F0DE 28 11                jr z,.p0s

1377+ F0E1 2C                   inc l
1378+ F0E2 7A                   ld a,d
1379+ F0E3 DD 84                add a,ixh
1380+ F0E5 57                   ld d,a
1381+ F0E6 7B                   ld a,e
1382+ F0E7 DD 85                add a,ixl
1383+ F0E9 30 02                jr nc,.pl1

1385+ F0EC 14                   inc d
1386+ F0ED 5F           .pl1:   ld e,a
1387+ F0EE 10 F0                djnz .pl
1388+ F0F0 C9                   ret
1389+ F0F1              ; (no x step: the accumulator kept in A and the remainder in E, not IXL)
1390+ F0F1 7B           .p0s:   ld a,e
1391+ F0F2 DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1392+ F0F4 72           .p0:    ld (hl),d

1394+ F0F6 83                   add a,e

1397+ F0FA 14                   inc d
1398+ F0FB 10 F7        .p01:   djnz .p0

1407+ F10A CD 0B E9     .ndv:   call div8
1408+ F10D DD 63                ld ixh,e
1409+ F10F DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1410+ F111 CD 3E F1             call .setup
1411+ F114 DD 7C                ld a,ixh
1412+ F116 B7                   or a
1413+ F117 28 11                jr z,.n0s
1414+ F119 72           .nl:    ld (hl),d
1415+ F11A 2C                   inc l
1416+ F11B 7A                   ld a,d
1417+ F11C DD 94                sub ixh
1418+ F11E 57                   ld d,a
1419+ F11F 7B                   ld a,e
1420+ F120 DD 85                add a,ixl
1421+ F122 30 02                jr nc,.nl1

1423+ F125 15                   dec d
1424+ F126 5F           .nl1:   ld e,a
1425+ F127 10 F0                djnz .nl
1426+ F129 C9                   ret

1428+ F12B DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1429+ F12D 72           .n0:    ld (hl),d

1431+ F12F 83                   add a,e
1432+ F130 30 02                jr nc,.n01
1433+ F132 81                   add a,c
1434+ F133 15                   dec d
1435+ F134 10 F7        .n01:   djnz .n0
1436+ F136 C9                   ret
1437+ F137
1438+ F137              ; A vertical edge: the same x on every row (as the steep walk gives it with
1439+ F137              ; no x step: exactly)
1440+ F137 41           .vert:  ld b,c
1441+ F138 04                   inc b                           ; dy+1 rows
1442+ F139 72           .vl:    ld (hl),d
1443+ F13A 2C                   inc l
1444+ F13B 10 FC                djnz .vl
1445+ F13D C9                   ret
1446+ F13E
1447+ F13E              ; B = dy+1 rows, E = biased accumulator (dy/2 - dy), C = -dy
1448+ F13E 41           .setup: ld b,c
1449+ F13F 04                   inc b
1450+ F140 79                   ld a,c
1451+ F141 CB 3F                srl a
1452+ F143 91                   sub c
1453+ F144 5F                   ld e,a
1454+ F145 79                   ld a,c
1455+ F146 ED 44                neg
1456+ F148 4F                   ld c,a
1457+ F149 C9                   ret
1458+ F14A
1459+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1460+ F14A              ; Span filler.  Rows fy0..fy1, x from TA/TB.  DE = colour pair.
1461+ F14A              ; Short spans use the stack pointer as a 2-byte write pointer into the frame
1462+ F14A              ; buffer (see push_blk), jumping into an unrolled block of PUSH DE.  Spans of
1463+ F14A              ; DMA_SPAN_MIN pixels or more are written by the zxnDMA, which only needs its
1464+ F14A              ; length and destination reloaded (see clear_screen).
1465+ F14A              ; For speed: the stack pointer is kept in IY (ld sp,iy), the rows are
1466+ F14A              ; counted down in IXH, and the table that is the left edge at the polygon's
1467+ F14A              ; middle row is read first, so the left / right swap (still made whenever
1468+ F14A              ; it's needed: a sliver's edges can cross) is mostly skipped.
1469+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1470+ F14A              fill_spans:
1471+ F14A 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1472+ F14D CD 20 E8             call seg_map                    ; first row's section into slot 0
1473+ F150 FD 21 00 00          ld iy,0
1474+ F154 FD 39                add iy,sp                       ; the stack, for push_end
1475+ F156 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1476+ F159 47                   ld b,a
1477+ F15A 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)
1478+ F15D 90                   sub b
1479+ F15E 3C                   inc a
1480+ F15F DD 67                ld ixh,a                        ; rows to fill
1481+ F161 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)                      ; the middle row: which table is left?
1482+ F164 80                   add a,b
1483+ F165 1F                   rra
1484+ F166 6F                   ld l,a
1485+ F167 26 E2                ld h,high TA
1486+ F169 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1487+ F16A 24                   inc h
1488+ F16B BE                   cp (hl)
1489+ F16C 3E E2                ld a,high TA                    ; TA left (or level): TA first
1490+ F16E 0E 24                ld c,$24                        ;   (inc h)
1491+ F170 38 04                jr c,.ta
1492+ F172 3E E3                ld a,high TB                    ; TB left: TB first
1493+ F174 0E 25                ld c,$25                        ;   (dec h)
1494+ F176 32 7E F1     .ta:    ld (fs_loop+1),a
1495+ F179 79                   ld a,c
1496+ F17A 32 81 F1             ld (fs_loop.tb),a
1497+ F17D
1498+ F17D              fs_loop:
1499+ F17D 26 E2                ld h,high TA                    ; (patched: the left table first)
1500+ F17F 68                   ld l,b
1501+ F180 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1502+ F181 24           .tb:    inc h                           ; (patched: inc h, or dec h, the other)
1503+ F182 4E                   ld c,(hl)
1504+ F183 B9                   cp c
1505+ F184 38 03                jr c,.ord
1506+ F186 69                   ld l,c
1507+ F187 4F                   ld c,a
1508+ F188 7D                   ld a,l
1509+ F189 6F           .ord:   ld l,a                          ; A = left x, C = right x
1510+ F18A 78                   ld a,b
1511+ F18B E6 1F                and 31
1512+ F18D 67                   ld h,a                          ; row within the paged section
1513+ F18E 79                   ld a,c
1514+ F18F 95                   sub l                           ; width-1
1515+ F190 FE 13                cp DMA_SPAN_MIN-1
1516+ F192 30 17                jr nc,.dma
1517+ F194 CB 3F        .push:  srl a
1518+ F196 38 07                jr c,.even
1519+ F198 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; odd width: single pixel first
1520+ F199 B7                   or a
1521+ F19A CA 84 E1             jp z,push_next                  ; (1 pixel: no PUSHes, so SP isn't
1522+ F19D 18 01                jr .go                          ; borrowed: see push_blk)
1523+ F19F 3C           .even:  inc a
1524+ F1A0 69           .go:    ld l,c
1525+ F1A1 23                   inc hl                          ; one past right edge (may be $C000)
1526+ F1A2 F9                   ld sp,hl
1527+ F1A3 6F                   ld l,a
1528+ F1A4 3E 80                ld a,low push_end - 1           ; (the DI before the last PUSH)
1529+ F1A6 95                   sub l
1530+ F1A7 6F                   ld l,a
1531+ F1A8 26 E1                ld h,high push_end
1532+ F1AA E9                   jp (hl)
1533+ F1AB                      ASSERT high push_blk == high push_end && low push_end - 1 - 128 == low push_blk
1534+ F1AB
1535+ F1AB                      ; Long span: zxnDMA from the fixed colour byte (port A) to HL.
1536+ F1AB                      ; Everything but length and destination was set up by clear_screen.
1537+ F1AB 3C           .dma:   inc a
1538+ F1AC 20 03                jr nz,.dmal
1539+ F1AE 3D                   dec a                           ; 256 wide: length needs the high
1540+ F1AF 18 E3                jr .push                        ; byte, so PUSH it (A = width-1)
1541+ F1B1              .dmal:
1542+ F1B1 4F                   ld c,a
1543+ F1B2 3E 25                ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_LO
1544+ F1B4 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1545+ F1B6 79                   ld a,c
1546+ F1B7 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; length = width
1547+ F1B9 3E AD                ld a,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE
1548+ F1BB D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1549+ F1BD 7D                   ld a,l
1550+ F1BE D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; port B = y*256 + x
1551+ F1C0 7C                   ld a,h
1552+ F1C1 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1553+ F1C3 3E CF                ld a,DMA_LOAD
1554+ F1C5 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1555+ F1C7 3E 87                ld a,DMA_ENABLE
1556+ F1C9 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; CPU waits until the span is written
1557+ F1CB 04                   inc b                           ; the next row (as push_next: SP was
1558+ F1CC DD 25                dec ixh                         ; never borrowed here)
1559+ F1CE C8                   ret z
1560+ F1CF 78                   ld a,b
1561+ F1D0 E6 1F                and 31
1562+ F1D2 C2 7D F1             jp nz,fs_loop
1563+ F1D5 C3 8E E1             jp push_next.sect
1564+ F1D8                      ASSERT high TB == high TA + 1

1566+ F1D8              ;==============================================================================
1567+ F1D8              ; Outline the polygon in p2buf, skipping edges flagged 0 (clip edges)
1568+ F1D8              ;==============================================================================
1569+ F1D8              outline_poly:
1570+ F1D8 DD 21 80 E0          ld ix,p2buf
1571+ F1DC 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1572+ F1DF 47                   ld b,a
1573+ F1E0 C5           .lp:    push bc
1574+ F1E1 DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
1575+ F1E4 B7                   or a
1576+ F1E5 28 0F                jr z,.sk
1577+ F1E7 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
1578+ F1EA DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1579+ F1ED DD 5E 04             ld e,(ix+4)
1580+ F1F0 DD 56 05             ld d,(ix+5)

1583+ F1F9 DD 09                add ix,bc
1584+ F1FB C1                   pop bc
1585+ F1FC 10 E2                djnz .lp
1586+ F1FE C9                   ret

1588+ F1FF              ;==============================================================================
1589+ F1FF              ; Bresenham line, on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
1590+ F1FF              ;   L = x0, H = y0, E = x1, D = y1, colour in line_col.  Preserves IX, IY.
1591+ F1FF              ;   Pages Layer 2 sections into slot 0 as the line crosses them.
1592+ F1FF              ;==============================================================================
1593+ F1FF              draw_line:

1595+ F202 4F                   ld c,a
1596+ F203 7B                   ld a,e
1597+ F204 95                   sub l
1598+ F205 30 06                jr nc,.xp
1599+ F207 ED 44                neg
1600+ F209 06 2D                ld b,OP_DEC_L
1601+ F20B 18 02                jr .xd
1602+ F20D 06 2C        .xp:    ld b,OP_INC_L
1603+ F20F 5F           .xd:    ld e,a                          ; |dx|
1604+ F210 78                   ld a,b
1605+ F211 32 39 F2             ld (.smx1),a
1606+ F214 32 56 F2             ld (.smx2),a

1608+ F218 94                   sub h
1609+ F219 30 06                jr nc,.yp

1611+ F21D 06 25                ld b,OP_DEC_H
1612+ F21F 18 02                jr .yd
1613+ F221 06 24        .yp:    ld b,OP_INC_H
1614+ F223 57           .yd:    ld d,a                          ; |dy|
1615+ F224 78                   ld a,b
1616+ F225 32 3D F2             ld (.smy1),a
1617+ F228 32 4D F2             ld (.smy2),a
1618+ F22B 7C                   ld a,h
1619+ F22C CD 20 E8             call seg_map                    ; page in the start row's section
1620+ F22F 67                   ld h,a                          ; y within the section
1621+ F230 7B                   ld a,e
1622+ F231 BA                   cp d
1623+ F232 38 13                jr c,.ymaj
1624+ F234 43                   ld b,e
1625+ F235 04                   inc b
1626+ F236 CB 3F                srl a
1627+ F238 71           .xl:    ld (hl),c
1628+ F239 2C           .smx1:  inc l
1629+ F23A 92                   sub d
1630+ F23B 30 07                jr nc,.xs
1631+ F23D 24           .smy1:  inc h
1632+ F23E CB 6C                bit 5,h                         ; left the 32-row section?
1633+ F240 C4 37 E8             call nz,line_seg
1634+ F243 83                   add a,e
1635+ F244 10 F2        .xs:    djnz .xl
1636+ F246 C9                   ret
1637+ F247 42           .ymaj:  ld b,d
1638+ F248 04                   inc b
1639+ F249 7A                   ld a,d
1640+ F24A CB 3F                srl a
1641+ F24C 71           .yl:    ld (hl),c
1642+ F24D 24           .smy2:  inc h
1643+ F24E CB 6C                bit 5,h
1644+ F250 C4 37 E8             call nz,line_seg
1645+ F253 93                   sub e
1646+ F254 30 02                jr nc,.ys

1648+ F257 82                   add a,d
1649+ F258 10 F2        .ys:    djnz .yl
1650+ F25A C9                   ret
1651+ F25B
1652+ F25B              ;==============================================================================
1653+ F25B              ; Clear the viewport (rows 0..VIEW_H-1) of the back buffer with the zxnDMA,
1654+ F25B              ; one 8K section (32 rows) at a time through slot 0: sky above the horizon
1655+ F25B              ; row, ground below.  The fills are dma_fill's (layer2_cls.asm, resident),
1656+ F25B              ; the l2_fill command block with its destination (port B) and length; the source
1657+ F25B              ; (port A) is the fixed byte l2_cls_byte.  Zero-length fills are skipped.
1658+ F25B              ;==============================================================================
1659+ F25B              clear_screen:
1660+ F25B 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; C = first row of the section
1661+ F25D 79           .sec:   ld a,c
1662+ F25E CD 20 E8             call seg_map
1663+ F261 3A 66 B6             ld a,(horizon)                  ; sky rows here = clamp(hz - C, 0, 32)
1664+ F264                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1665+ F264 3C                   inc a                           ; the horizon row too: at the horizon
1666+ F265                                                      ; it is all distant wall, and it hides
1667+ F265                                                      ; a 1-row rounding gap under the
1668+ F265                                                      ; wall's top edge when pitched
1669+ F265                  ENDIF
1670+ F265 91                   sub c
1671+ F266 30 01                jr nc,.s1
1672+ F268 AF                   xor a
1673+ F269 FE 21        .s1:    cp 33
1674+ F26B 38 02                jr c,.s2
1675+ F26D 3E 20                ld a,32
1676+ F26F 32 EE E0     .s2:    ld (cs_sky),a
1677+ F272 B7                   or a
1678+ F273 28 0D                jr z,.gnd
1679+ F275 C5                   push bc
1680+ F276 47                   ld b,a                          ; sky: section start, rows*256 bytes
1681+ F277 0E 00                ld c,0
1682+ F279 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1683+ F27C                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1684+ F27C 3E 01                ld a,WALL_FAMILY*4+SHADE_FACE   ; "sky" is the perimeter wall
1685+ F27E                  ELSE
1686+ F27E ~                    ld a,SKY_COL
1687+ F27E                  ENDIF
1688+ F27E CD FF A7             call dma_fill
1689+ F281 C1                   pop bc
1690+ F282 3A EE E0     .gnd:   ld a,(cs_sky)
1691+ F285 FE 20                cp 32
1692+ F287 28 11                jr z,.nx
1693+ F289 C5                   push bc
1694+ F28A 67                   ld h,a                          ; ground: after the sky rows
1695+ F28B 2E 00                ld l,0
1696+ F28D ED 44                neg
1697+ F28F C6 20                add a,32
1698+ F291 47                   ld b,a
1699+ F292 0E 00                ld c,0
1700+ F294 3E 07                ld a,GROUND_COL
1701+ F296 CD FF A7             call dma_fill
1702+ F299 C1                   pop bc
1703+ F29A 79           .nx:    ld a,c
1704+ F29B C6 20                add a,32
1705+ F29D 4F                   ld c,a
1706+ F29E FE 80                cp VIEW_H
1707+ F2A0 20 BB                jr nz,.sec
1708+ F2A2                      ; Leave the DMA ready for fill_spans: length high byte 0, so each span
1709+ F2A2                      ; only reloads length low, destination, LOAD and ENABLE.  fill_poly
1710+ F2A2                      ; puts each building's colour in the source byte l2_cls_byte.
1711+ F2A2 3E 45        .spans: ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_HI
1712+ F2A4 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1713+ F2A6 AF                   xor a
1714+ F2A7 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1715+ F2A9 C9                   ret
1716+ F2AA
1717+ F2AA
1718+ F2AA              ;==============================================================================
1719+ F2AA              ; City traversal - back to front without sorting.
1720+ F2AA              ;   For grid-aligned boxes in separate cells, a box can only hide boxes whose
1721+ F2AA              ;   cell offsets from the camera cell are larger (or equal) on both axes in
1722+ F2AA              ;   the same quadrant.  So: rows from the far edges inwards, and within each
1723+ F2AA              ;   row columns from the far edges inwards, the camera row/column last.
1724+ F2AA              ;==============================================================================
1725+ F2AA              draw_city:
1726+ F2AA CD 65 F3             call walk_patch                 ; this frame's cell steps
1727+ F2AD                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1728+ F2AD CD A1 85             call occ_begin
1729+ F2B0 3A C1 F8             ld a,(occ_on)
1730+ F2B3 B7                   or a
1731+ F2B4 28 13                jr z,draw_cells                 ; pitched: the painter's order as is
1732+ F2B6 CD D9 85             call occ_cells                  ; front to back: keep what isn't hidden
1733+ F2B9 3A C2 F8             ld a,(occ_full)
1734+ F2BC B7                   or a
1735+ F2BD CA 1D 89             jp z,occ_draw_list              ; back to front: draw it
1736+ F2C0 AF                   xor a                           ; too many to keep: draw this frame
1737+ F2C1 32 C1 F8             ld (occ_on),a                   ; the plain way
1738+ F2C4 3E 80                ld a,VIEW_H
1739+ F2C6 32 F5 F8             ld (bld_cut),a                  ; (and nothing cut)
1740+ F2C9                  ENDIF
1741+ F2C9              draw_cells:
1742+ F2C9 3A 8C B6             ld a,(cz)
1743+ F2CC 21 79 AF             ld hl,view_r
1744+ F2CF 96                   sub (hl)
1745+ F2D0 32 A6 F8             ld (cell_j),a
1746+ F2D3 3A A6 F8     .b:     ld a,(cell_j)
1747+ F2D6 21 8C B6             ld hl,cz
1748+ F2D9 BE                   cp (hl)
1749+ F2DA 28 09                jr z,.f
1750+ F2DC CD 01 F3             call draw_row
1751+ F2DF 21 A6 F8             ld hl,cell_j
1752+ F2E2 34                   inc (hl)
1753+ F2E3 18 EE                jr .b
1754+ F2E5 3A 8C B6     .f:     ld a,(cz)
1755+ F2E8 21 79 AF             ld hl,view_r
1756+ F2EB 86                   add a,(hl)
1757+ F2EC 32 A6 F8             ld (cell_j),a
1758+ F2EF 3A A6 F8     .f2:    ld a,(cell_j)
1759+ F2F2 21 8C B6             ld hl,cz
1760+ F2F5 BE                   cp (hl)
1761+ F2F6 28 09                jr z,draw_row                   ; camera row last
1762+ F2F8 CD 01 F3             call draw_row
1763+ F2FB 21 A6 F8             ld hl,cell_j
1764+ F2FE 35                   dec (hl)
1765+ F2FF 18 EE                jr .f2
1766+ F301
1767+ F301              ; The cell walks (draw_row here, occ_row in city2.asm) keep the cell's
1768+ F301              ; yaw-space centre (X, Z1) in the alternate registers HL', DE' (nothing else
1769+ F301              ; uses the alternate set, the interrupt routine included), and step it one
1770+ F301              ; cell at a time by (cosY, sinY), patched into the steps each frame
1771+ F301              ; (walk_patch).  draw_bld reads it from there.
1772+ F301              draw_row:
1773+ F301 3A A6 F8             ld a,(cell_j)
1774+ F304 FE 40                cp GRID
1775+ F306 D0                   ret nc
1776+ F307 CD 84 F3             call row_base
1777+ F30A 3A 8B B6             ld a,(cx)
1778+ F30D 21 79 AF             ld hl,view_r
1779+ F310 96                   sub (hl)
1780+ F311 32 A5 F8             ld (cell_i),a
1781+ F314 CD A3 F3             call row_start
1782+ F317 3A A5 F8     .l:     ld a,(cell_i)
1783+ F31A 21 8B B6             ld hl,cx
1784+ F31D BE                   cp (hl)
1785+ F31E 28 15                jr z,.r
1786+ F320 CD D0 F3             call try_cell
1787+ F323 21 A5 F8             ld hl,cell_i
1788+ F326 34                   inc (hl)
1789+ F327 D9                   exx                             ; one cell +x: (X,Z1) += (cosY,sinY)
1790+ F328 01 00 00     .cp:    ld bc,0                         ; (cosY: walk_patch)
1791+ F32B 09                   add hl,bc
1792+ F32C EB                   ex de,hl
1793+ F32D 01 00 00     .sp:    ld bc,0                         ; (sinY)
1794+ F330 09                   add hl,bc
1795+ F331 EB                   ex de,hl
1796+ F332 D9                   exx
1797+ F333 18 E2                jr .l
1798+ F335 3A 8B B6     .r:     ld a,(cx)
1799+ F338 21 79 AF             ld hl,view_r
1800+ F33B 86                   add a,(hl)
1801+ F33C 32 A5 F8             ld (cell_i),a
1802+ F33F CD A3 F3             call row_start
1803+ F342 3A A5 F8     .r2:    ld a,(cell_i)
1804+ F345 21 8B B6             ld hl,cx
1805+ F348 BE                   cp (hl)

1961+ F427              BLD_R           equ 256             ; cull radius: 181 (half diagonal) * sqrt2
1962+ F427              draw_bld:

1964+ F427                      ; |X|*c <= Z1 with c = cosP - 0.5|sinP|.  Reject the bounding circle
1965+ F427                      ; (radius BLD_R) round the cell's yaw-space centre (X, Z1, kept up
1966+ F427                      ; to date in HL', DE' by the walk).  First, as it needs nothing else:
1967+ F427                      ; most cells it rejects then cost no more.  (Level flight: c is
1968+ F427                      ; exactly 1.0, so no multiply.)

   9+ 8000              ; bank 5 whatever the CPU has mapped), and the interrupt routine uses only
  10+ 8000              ; slots 1 and 5, so interrupts stay on.  Both pages are mapped together, so
  11+ 8000              ; code and data in either call or use the other directly (labels are global).
  12+ 8000              ;
  13+ 8000              ; Here: the street dots, the bullets, rockets and particles, the gunsight and
  14+ 8000              ; the occlusion culling.  Their variables stay in the city page.  Anything
  15+ 8000              ; that calls into this page from outside main_loop's city part must map it
  16+ 8000              ; first (nextreg CITY2_MMU,PAGE_CITY2) and put the ULA screen back after.
  17+ 8000              ;==============================================================================

  19+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ 8000              ; Street intersection markers - one dot per grid corner near the camera
  21+ 8000              ; whose 4 cells are all open: no building, terrace or pad cell touches it
  22+ 8000              ; (out of bounds counts as open: it is never drawn).  A corner a building
  23+ 8000              ; touches is always drawn over by it (its faces cover their own corners, and
  24+ 8000              ; the box hides those behind it), so it isn't worked out at all.
  25+ 8000              ;   A row's corners have cells j-1 above and j below; each corner shares its
  26+ 8000              ; left pair of cells with the corner before, so one pair is read a corner.
  27+ 8000              ; An open corner's (X, Z1) is its row's first corner's (worked out once, by
  28+ 8000              ; full rotation, only if the row has an open corner) + k (cosY, sinY), k its
  29+ 8000              ; column in the row: exactly what stepping +256 world units k times gives.
  30+ 8000              ;==============================================================================

 817+ 85A1
 818+ 85A1                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
 819+ 85A1              ;==============================================================================
 820+ 85A1              ; Occlusion culling (OCCLUSION_CULL, level flight only)
 821+ 85A1              ;
 822+ 85A1              ; In level flight every screen column is a vertical slice of the world through
 823+ 85A1              ; the camera.  The cells are walked in exactly the reverse of the painter's
 824+ 85A1              ; order, i.e. front to back.  Each building is transformed as usual, then
 825+ 85A1              ; tested against OCC_YBUF, which holds per column the row from which the
 826+ 85A1              ; screen is known to be covered down to the ground:
 827+ 85A1              ;   * hidden - in every column it spans, its highest point is no higher than
 828+ 85A1              ;     that row - it is dropped;
 829+ 85A1              ;   * otherwise it lowers the row across its columns to its lowest top
 830+ 85A1              ;     corner, and its corners and face settings are kept in a record.
 831+ 85A1              ; The kept buildings and the zombie cells are then drawn back to front.
 832+ 85A1              ; This is safe because buildings that share a column meet the walk front to
 833+ 85A1              ; back (the grid order guarantees it), the camera is above the ground (what
 834+ 85A1              ; is behind sits higher on screen), the cover row is the lowest top corner
 835+ 85A1              ; (an underestimate) and bounds are clamped inwards to the screen.  A
 836+ 85A1              ; building with a corner behind the camera is never dropped and never covers.
 837+ 85A1              ;==============================================================================
 838+ 85A1              OCC_YBUF        equ $4000       ; per column: covered from this row down
 839+ 85A1              OCC_YBUF8       equ $4200       ; per 8 columns: at least the most of
 840+ 85A1                                              ; OCC_YBUF's 8 (its own page, before the
 841+ 85A1                                              ; records), so a hidden test can pass 8
 842+ 85A1                                              ; columns at once
 843+ 85A1              OCC_LIST        equ $4100       ; kept buildings and zombie cells, 2 bytes each
 844+ 85A1              OCC_REC0        equ $43         ; the records' first page; two records a
 845+ 85A1              OCC_RECN        equ $60         ; page (128 bytes each, at +0 and +128), up
 846+ 85A1                                              ; to $5F: 58 records ($6000 on: city_col).
 847+ 85A1                                              ; The busiest street view at the full draw
 848+ 85A1                                              ; distance (8 tiles) keeps 35.
 849+ 85A1              ; Record: copy of vtx's 8 corners, bytes 0-8 of each 16 (X, Y, Z, outcode,
 850+ 85A1              ; sx, sy), at the same offsets from the record's start, and in the first
 851+ 85A1              ; corner's spare bytes
 852+ 85A1              OR_VIS          equ 9           ; bld_vis, bld_mx, bld_mz, col_x, col_z, col_top,
 853+ 85A1              OR_N            equ 7           ;   bld_cut
 854+ 85A1                      ASSERT OR_VIS + OR_N <= 16
 855+ 85A1                      ASSERT bld_cut == bld_vis + OR_N - 1
 856+ 85A1                      ASSERT low OCC_YBUF8 == 0       ; (occ_cut: the low byte is the group)
 857+ 85A1              ; A record in a page's upper half is drawn with the +128 corner lists
 858+ 85A1              ; (face_set = FACE_SET2, city.asm).
 859+ 85A1              ; A list entry is a record's address ($4300-$5FFF), a cell with humans as
 860+ 85A1              ; its city_col address ($6000-$6FFF) or a cell with zombies as its city_map
 861+ 85A1              ; address ($7000-$7FFF).
 862+ 85A1
 863+ 85A1              ; Start of the city: occlusion on only in level flight
 864+ 85A1              occ_begin:
 865+ 85A1 AF                   xor a
 866+ 85A2 32 C1 F8             ld (occ_on),a
 867+ 85A5 32 C2 F8             ld (occ_full),a
 868+ 85A8 3A 69 AF             ld a,(pitch)
 869+ 85AB B7                   or a
 870+ 85AC C0                   ret nz
 871+ 85AD 3C                   inc a
 872+ 85AE 32 C1 F8             ld (occ_on),a
 873+ 85B1 21 00 41             ld hl,OCC_LIST
 874+ 85B4 22 C3 F8             ld (occ_lp),hl
 875+ 85B7 21 00 43             ld hl,OCC_REC0*256
 876+ 85BA 22 C5 F8             ld (occ_rp),hl
 877+ 85BD 21 00 40             ld hl,OCC_YBUF                  ; nothing covered yet: by DMA (about
 878+ 85C0 01 00 01             ld bc,256                       ; 1,500 T less than an LDIR), then
 879+ 85C3 3E 80                ld a,VIEW_H                     ; the DMA left ready for the spans
 880+ 85C5 CD FF A7             call dma_fill
 881+ 85C8 CD A2 F2             call clear_screen.spans
 882+ 85CB 21 00 42             ld hl,OCC_YBUF8                 ; (and so in every group of 8)
 883+ 85CE 36 80                ld (hl),VIEW_H
 884+ 85D0 11 01 42             ld de,OCC_YBUF8+1
 885+ 85D3 01 1F 00             ld bc,31
 886+ 85D6 ED B0                ldir
 887+ 85D8 C9                   ret
 888+ 85D9
 889+ 85D9              ; The cells of draw_cells in exactly the reverse order.  Each half row
 890+ 85D9              ; starts from the same cell as draw_row and steps the same way, so every
 891+ 85D9              ; cell gets bit-identical yaw-space coordinates.
 892+ 85D9              occ_cells:

 902+ 85EE C1                   pop bc

 905+ 85F4 32 A6 F8             ld (cell_j),a
 906+ 85F7 3A 79 AF             ld a,(view_r)

 916+ 8607              ; One row front to back.  (X, Z1) is the walk's, in HL', DE' (as draw_row's,
 917+ 8607              ; city.asm), stepped one cell at a time by (cosY, sinY) patched in by
 918+ 8607              ; walk_patch.  Each half starts where draw_row's does and gets to the camera
 919+ 8607              ; column by k steps at once (walk_back, walk_fwd: exactly k single steps).

 321+ E200
 322+ E200              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 323+ E200              ; Weapon slots: a column for each, at columns WPN_COL0, +2, ... in the order
 324+ E200              ; wpn_order (as numbered on keys 1-5: 2 4 1 5 3).  From the top:
 325+ E200              ;   * row WPN_NUM_ROW: its slot number, yellow if selected; none if unused;
 326+ E200              ;   * rows WPN_ROW..: a bar 1 character wide and WPN_BAR high, its ammo one
 327+ E200              ;     digit a row in black, hundreds at the top (infinite ammo: INF).  Green;
 328+ E200              ;     red with no ammo left; black if unused.  An unused slot that was asked
 329+ E200              ;     for flashes amber / black (WFLASH frames each, 3 times);
 330+ E200              ;   * row WPN_LTR_ROW: the letter of its weapon (wpn_glyph), yellow if
 331+ E200              ;     selected.
 332+ E200              ; The selected slot also has a yellow line above and below the bar, in the
 333+ E200              ; number's and the letter's cells (a cell has one ink: in the bar's they
 334+ E200              ; would be black).  Checked every frame, redrawn only when it changes
 335+ E200              ; (wd_shown).
 336+ E200              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 337+ E200              WPN_ATTR_ON     equ C_OK<<3             ; paper green, ink black
 338+ E200              WPN_ATTR_OUT    equ C_WARN<<3           ; paper red
 339+ E200              WPN_ATTR_OFF    equ P_EMPTY<<3          ; paper black
 340+ E200              WPN_ATTR_FLASH  equ C_AMBER<<3          ; paper amber
 341+ E200              WPN_NUM_ATTR    equ P_PANEL<<3 | 7
 342+ E200              WPN_SEL_ATTR    equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_YEL
 343+ E200              WPN_BMP         equ ULA_BMP + (WPN_ROW/8)*$800 + (WPN_ROW&7)*32 + WPN_COL0
 344+ E200                      ASSERT WPN_NUM_ROW/8 == WPN_LTR_ROW/8   ; the rows in one third
 345+ E200                      ASSERT WPN_COL0 + 2*(WPN_SLOTS-1) < MAP_COL
 346+ E200

 618+ E3C4              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 619+ E3C4              ; Layer 2 double buffering with the hardware shadow register.
 620+ E3C4              ;   NextReg $12 = active bank (on screen), NextReg $13 = shadow bank.
 621+ E3C4              ; The game always draws into the shadow bank; l2_flip swaps the two during
 622+ E3C4              ; vertical blank, so the registers themselves record which buffer is which.

 625+ E3C4              ;==============================================================================
 626+ E3C4              ; HUD: the weapon slots, and the speed, altitude and ground height gauges
 627+ E3C4              ; (the humans and the compass are hardware sprites: hud_sprites.asm).  The
 628+ E3C4              ; gauges are vertical bars on Layer 2 (in the back buffer, every frame)
 629+ E3C4              ; behind transparent ULA cells: the
 630+ E3C4              ; altitude and ground bars share one 8-pixel cell column, which ULA
 631+ E3C4              ; attributes couldn't colour (green, amber and black in one cell).

 643+ E3D0              ;      green, red when reversing, amber while boosting (full: BOOST_SPEED is
 644+ E3D0              ;      past the top)
 645+ E3D0              ;   A  left 4 pixels: altitude, green; right 4: the height of the city tile
 646+ E3D0              ;      under the craft (0 on a road), amber.  Both 1 pixel per 4 units, so
 647+ E3D0              ;      the ceiling (MAX_Y, 179) nearly fills the bar, 44 of 48; with the
 648+ E3D0              ;      vertical thrusters 1 per 8, so their ceiling (MAX_Y_THRUST, 384) does.
 649+ E3D0              ;      A tile taller than the bar's top fills it.  The ground under the
 650+ E3D0              ;      craft is always lower, so the gap between them is the clearance.
 651+ E3D0              ;   B  the booster's fuel, 8 wide: fuel * 62 / 256 pixels, so BOOST_FUEL_MAX
 652+ E3D0              ;      (200) fills it; green.  Drawn always, but its cells are opaque panel

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - input: keyboard and joysticks (8K page PAGE_INPUT, runs at
   3+ E000              ; $E000 in slot 7: main_loop and the menu page it in, and the game logic
   4+ E000              ; pages in slot 6 call it)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; Redefinable controls.  An input (a key, or a joystick direction or button)
   7+ E000              ; is a 16-bit code: high byte = input bank, low byte = bit mask within it.
   8+ E000              ;   banks 0-7: the ZX Spectrum keyboard half-rows (port $xxFE, address line
   9+ E000              ;              A8+bank low): read 0 = pressed
  10+ E000              ;   bank 8:    NextReg $B0, Extended Keys 0: read 1 = pressed
  11+ E000              ;   bank 9:    NextReg $B1, Extended Keys 1: read 1 = pressed
  12+ E000              ;   bank 10:   port $1F, Kempston 1 / Mega Drive 1 (J1_*): read 1 = pressed
  13+ E000              ;   bank 11:   port $37, Kempston 2 / Mega Drive 2 (J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  14+ E000              ;   bank 12:   NextReg $B2, the 6-button Mega Drive pads' X, Y, Z and MODE
  15+ E000              ;              (left connector J1_*, right J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  16+ E000              ; A joystick bank is read only while a joystick is set (NextReg $05, the
  17+ E000              ; Next's joystick modes) to the port it reads, else it is 0: so an unused
  18+ E000              ; port can't read as everything pressed.  Joysticks in Sinclair or Cursor
  19+ E000              ; mode enter keys (6-0, 1-5, 5-8) and are read as keys.
  20+ E000              ; kbd_scan, once per frame at the top of the main loop, reads all the banks
  21+ E000              ; into key_now, inverting the ZX rows so that every bank holds 1 = pressed,
  22+ E000              ; and keeps the previous scan in key_prev.  The game asks about actions
  23+ E000              ; (K_FIRE, K_LEFT, ...), not inputs: each action has a key (key_defs) and a
  24+ E000              ; joystick input (joy_defs; 0 = none), either of which works, so both can
  25+ E000              ; be redefined (key_define) at any time.
  26+ E000              ;   key_held    A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input is down
  27+ E000              ;   key_pressed A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input went down
  28+ E000              ;               since the last scan
  29+ E000              ;   key_find    -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (for a
  30+ E000              ;               redefine screen); Z if none
  31+ E000              ;   key_code_pressed  HL = key code -> NZ if that key went down
  32+ E000              ; The Next normally also enters the extended keys into the 8x5 matrix (e.g.
  33+ E000              ; cursor LEFT as CAPS SHIFT + 5).  NextReg $68 bit 4 stops that: set it with
  34+ E000              ; kbd_double_on (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE), clear it with kbd_double_off
  35+ E000              ; (FALSE, the default).
  36+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  37+ E000

 150+ E000              ; Read all the input banks: key_prev = last scan, key_now = this one, every

 250+ E095              ; A = a Kempston / Mega Drive port read -> A, or 0 if it reads left and

 261+ E09E              ; Stop the extended keys also appearing in the 8x5 matrix:
 262+ E09E              ; KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE, NextReg $68 bit 4 = 1

 273+ E0A3              ; A = TRUE / FALSE: store it, and set NextReg $68 bit 4 to match, keeping

 290+ E0BE              ; A = action -> NZ if its key or its joystick input is down.  Preserves BC,

 306+ E0CF              ; A = action -> NZ if its key or its joystick input is down now but wasn't

 321+ E0E4
 322+ E0E4              ; HL -> key_now[bank], A = mask -> NZ if down now but not at the last scan

 324+ E0E4              def_new:

 359+ E109              ; A = action -> HL -> key_now[its key's bank], A = its key's mask

 364+ E10C              ; HL = key_defs or joy_defs, A = action -> HL -> key_now[the bank], A = mask
 365+ E10C              def_at:

 383+ E11F              ; A = action, HL = an input's code: redefine the action's key, or its
 384+ E11F              ; joystick input if the code is a joystick's (bank JOY_BANK on).  Uses B.
 385+ E11F              key_define:
 386+ E11F EB                   ex de,hl
 387+ E120 87                   add a,a
 388+ E121 21 70 E1             ld hl,key_defs

 402+ E135              ; -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (lowest bank, lowest bit); Z
 403+ E135              ; if none.  For a redefine screen.
 404+ E135              key_find:

 406+ E138 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; bank
 407+ E13A 7E           .b:     ld a,(hl)

 417+ E147 06 01        .got:   ld b,1                          ; lowest bit set
 418+ E149 1F           .m:     rra
 419+ E14A 38 04                jr c,.f
 420+ E14C CB 20                sla b
 421+ E14E 18 F9                jr .m
 422+ E150 61           .f:     ld h,c
 423+ E151 68                   ld l,b
 424+ E152 F6 01                or 1                            ; NZ
 425+ E154 C9                   ret

 430+ E155              KBD_STOP_DOUBLING:
 431+ E155 00                       db FALSE                    ; TRUE: NextReg $68 bit 4 set, extended
 432+ E156                                                      ; keys kept out of the 8x5 matrix
 433+ E156 00 00 00...  key_now:    ds KEY_BANKS                ; this scan, 1 = pressed

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - hardware sprites, Layer 3 (8K page PAGE_SPRITES, runs at $E000
   3+ E000              ; in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; The Next has 128 hardware sprites, each 16x16 pixels from a pattern in the
   6+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory (16K, separate from the Z80's: 64 8-bit patterns of
   7+ E000              ; 256 bytes, one byte per pixel, row by row).  A pattern byte is an index
   8+ E000              ; into the sprite palette; SPR_TRANS ($E3, NextReg $4B) is transparent.  The
   9+ E000              ; sprite palette starts as the identity, so until spr_palette changes it a
  10+ E000              ; pattern byte is simply its RRRGGGBB colour.
  11+ E000              ;
  12+ E000              ; Sprites are drawn above Layer 2 and the ULA (priority S U L) and, with
  13+ E000              ; NextReg $15 bit 1 set, over the border as well, so the sprite screen is
  14+ E000              ; 320 x 256 pixels:
  15+ E000              ;
  16+ E000              ;     x 0..319, y 0..255;  (SPR_SCREEN_X, SPR_SCREEN_Y) = (32, 32) is the top
  17+ E000              ;     left of the 256x192 Layer 2 / ULA screen, (288, 224) its bottom right
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; A sprite's position is its top left pixel.  Coordinates are 9 bits and
  20+ E000              ; wrap round at 512, so they may be negative (two's complement): a sprite at
  21+ E000              ; x = -8 shows its right half at the left edge.  With overlapping sprites,
  22+ E000              ; the higher numbered one is drawn on top.
  23+ E000              ;
  24+ E000              ; Use: sprites_init once (start-up), load patterns with spr_patterns or
  25+ E000              ; from a sprite bank (sprite_data.asm: page the bank into slot 7 and call
  26+ E000              ; its spr_load_bank, from outside slot 7), and a palette with spr_palette
  27+ E000              ; if wanted, then set up sprites in the shadow
  28+ E000              ; table with spr_set / spr_pos / spr_pattern / spr_flags / spr_scale /
  29+ E000              ; spr_hide / spr_show / spr_hide_all, and copy the table to the hardware
  30+ E000              ; once a frame with spr_update.  The table holds the first SPR_COUNT sprites;
  31+ E000              ; the rest stay hidden.
  32+ E000              ;
  33+ E000              ; Attributes, SPR_ATTR (5) bytes a sprite, kept in the table as they are
  34+ E000              ; sent (the 5-byte form):
  35+ E000              ;   +0  x bits 0-7
  36+ E000              ;   +1  y bits 0-7
  37+ E000              ;   +2  bits 7-4 palette offset (added to the pattern byte's top nibble),
  38+ E000              ;       bit 3 x mirror, 2 y mirror, 1 rotate 90 degrees clockwise, 0 x bit 8
  39+ E000              ;   +3  bit 7 visible, bit 6 = 1 (byte +4 follows), bits 5-0 pattern
  40+ E000              ;   +4  bits 4-3 x scale, bits 2-1 y scale (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8), 0 y bit 8
  41+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  42+ E000
  43+ E000              SPR_COUNT       equ 44          ; sprites in the shadow table (max 128)
  44+ E000              SPR_HW          equ 128         ; hardware sprites
  45+ E000              SPR_ATTR        equ 5           ; attribute bytes per sprite
  46+ E000              SPR_PATTERNS    equ 64          ; 8-bit 16x16 patterns in pattern memory
  47+ E000              SPR_SIZE        equ 16          ; pixels, each way (at scale x1)
  48+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_X    equ 32          ; sprite coordinates of the 256x192
  49+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_Y    equ 32          ; screen's top left pixel
  50+ E000              SPR_TRANS       equ $E3         ; transparent pattern byte (NextReg $4B)
  51+ E000
  52+ E000              SPRF_PAL        equ $10         ; flags (attribute +2): palette offset x 16,
  53+ E000              SPRF_XMIRROR    equ $08         ; mirror left-right,
  54+ E000              SPRF_YMIRROR    equ $04         ; mirror top-bottom,
  55+ E000              SPRF_ROT        equ $02         ; rotate 90 degrees clockwise
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              SPR_SLOT_PORT   equ $303B       ; write: select sprite / pattern slot
  58+ E000              SPR_ATTR_PORT   equ $57         ; write: attributes, from the selected sprite
  59+ E000              SPR_PAT_PORT    equ $5B         ; write: pattern bytes, from the selected slot
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  62+ E000              ; Start-up: sprites on, shown over the border too (the full 320 x 256),
  63+ E000              ; priority S U L; the transparent index; every hardware sprite hidden and the shadow table cleared (all hidden,
  64+ E000              ; pattern 0, at 0,0).
  65+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ E000              sprites_init:
  67+ E000 ED 91 15 0B          nextreg $15,%00001011           ; priority S U L, sprites over the
  68+ E004                                                      ; border (bit 1), visible (bit 0)
  69+ E004 ED 91 4B E3          nextreg $4B,SPR_TRANS
  70+ E008 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT             ; from sprite 0, the 4-byte form
  71+ E00B AF                   xor a                           ; (+3 bit 6 clear): all hidden
  72+ E00C ED 79                out (c),a
  73+ E00E 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
  74+ E010 11 00 02             ld de,SPR_HW*4
  75+ E013 ED 79        .hw:    out (c),a
  76+ E015 1B                   dec de
  77+ E016 7A                   ld a,d
  78+ E017 B3                   or e
  79+ E018 3E 00                ld a,0
  80+ E01A 20 F7                jr nz,.hw
  81+ E01C 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
  82+ E01F 06 2C                ld b,SPR_COUNT
  83+ E021 77           .sh:    ld (hl),a                       ; x, y, flags 0
  84+ E022 23                   inc hl
  85+ E023 77                   ld (hl),a
  86+ E024 23                   inc hl
  87+ E025 77                   ld (hl),a
  88+ E026 23                   inc hl
  89+ E027 36 40                ld (hl),$40                     ; hidden, 5-byte form, pattern 0
  90+ E029 23                   inc hl
  91+ E02A 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; scale x1
  92+ E02B 23                   inc hl
  93+ E02C 10 F3                djnz .sh
  94+ E02E                      ; fall through: send it
  95+ E02E
  96+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E02E              ; Copy the shadow table to sprites 0..SPR_COUNT-1.  Once a frame, after the
  98+ E02E              ; changes (best just after the frame flip, so a move doesn't show half done).
  99+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100+ E02E              spr_update:
 101+ E02E 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 102+ E031 AF                   xor a
 103+ E032 ED 79                out (c),a                       ; from sprite 0
 104+ E034 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 105+ E037 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
 106+ E039 16 2C                ld d,SPR_COUNT
 107+ E03B 06 05        .lp:    ld b,SPR_ATTR
 108+ E03D ED B3                otir
 109+ E03F 15                   dec d
 110+ E040 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 111+ E042 C9                   ret
 112+ E043
 113+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 114+ E043              ; Load B 8-bit patterns (256 bytes each) from HL into pattern memory, from
 115+ E043              ; pattern A (0..63).  HL ends past them.
 116+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 117+ E043              spr_patterns:
 118+ E043 50                   ld d,b
 119+ E044 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 120+ E047 ED 79                out (c),a
 121+ E049 0E 5B                ld c,SPR_PAT_PORT

 123+ E04D ED B3                otir
 124+ E04F 15                   dec d

 126+ E052 C9                   ret

 128+ E053              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 129+ E053              ; Load B colours (8-bit RRRGGGBB) from HL into the sprite palette, from

 142+ E062              ; Sprite A (0..SPR_COUNT-1) in the shadow table.  BC = x, DE = y (sprite
 143+ E062              ; screen, signed 9 bits), H = pattern (0..63), L = flags (SPRF_*).  Shows it.

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - start-up initialisation (8K page PAGE_INIT, runs at $E000 in
   3+ E000              ; slot 7)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Code needed only once, at start-up, kept out of the resident page: start
   6+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm) pages this in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INIT and calls
   7+ E000              ; initgame, then slot 7 is free for the other core pages.
   8+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E000
  10+ E000              ; Hardware set-up: 28MHz, Layer 2 mode, transparency, layer priority, Layer
  11+ E000              ; 2 scroll and clip window, the memory map of the always-mapped slots, the
  12+ E000              ; peripheral settings (AY sound, turbo sound, internal speaker, no
  13+ E000              ; contention), and a black border.
  14+ E000              initgame:
  15+ E000 ED 91 07 03          nextreg $07,3                   ; 28MHz
  16+ E004 ED 91 70 00          nextreg $70,0                   ; Layer 2 256x192 mode
  17+ E008 ED 91 14 E3          nextreg $14,$E3                 ; global transparency colour
  18+ E00C ED 91 15 08          nextreg $15,%00001000           ; priority S U L (ULA over L2); sprites
  19+ E010                                                      ; off until sprites_init
  20+ E010 ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
  21+ E014 ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
  22+ E018 ED 91 1C 01          nextreg $1C,%00000001           ; reset L2 clip index
  23+ E01C ED 91 18 00          nextreg $18,0                   ; Layer 2 clip: x 0..255,
  24+ E020 ED 91 18 FF          nextreg $18,255

  26+ E028 ED 91 18 BF          nextreg $18,191                 ; city map through the ULA panel

  29+ E034 ED 91 52 06          nextreg OCC_MMU,PAGE_OCC0       ; occlusion data at $4000-$5FFF,
  30+ E038 ED 91 53 07          nextreg TABLES_MMU,PAGE_OCC1    ; city_col at $6000-$6FFF
  31+ E03C                      ; Peripheral settings.  $06 and $08 are read, changed and written
  32+ E03C                      ; back, so the bits not named here keep their values (in $06, bit 4
  33+ E03C                      ; is the divMMC automap, which the file handler's RST $08 needs).
  34+ E03C 3E 06                ld a,$06                        ; Peripheral 2: audio chip mode
  35+ E03E CD 0F AA             call read_nextreg               ; (bits 1-0) = %01, AY

  37+ E043 F6 01                or %00000001
