# file opened: file_handler.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - file handling: loading and saving on the SD card (8K page
   3+ E000              ; PAGE_FILE, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg
   4+ E000              ; CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE before calling)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; General-purpose routines over the esxDOS / NextZXOS file API (RST $08 with
   7+ E000              ; a function code after it).  Game-specific loading and saving (save games,
   8+ E000              ; high scores, settings) go on top of these.
   9+ E000              ;
  10+ E000              ; The ROM: the divMMC only traps RST $08 while the ROM is paged in at
  11+ E000              ; $0000-$3FFF, but the game keeps other pages there (slot 0: a Layer 2
  12+ E000              ; section or the sine table; slot 1: the zombie page).  So every call pages
  13+ E000              ; the ROM into slots 0 and 1 (fh_rom_in), makes the RST $08, then puts the
  14+ E000              ; game's pages back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off over the call (the
  15+ E000              ; game's IM 2 routine is in slot 1, covered by the ROM, and IY is in use and
  16+ E000              ; slot 2 holds game data, so the ROM's routine must not run either), and
  17+ E000              ; fh_rom_out turns them back on if they were on.
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; Rules for callers:
  20+ E000              ;   * page this in at $E000 (slot 7) first, and call from outside slot 7:
  21+ E000              ;     resident code or a game logic page in slot 6;
  22+ E000              ;   * file names and data buffers must be in $4000-$DFFF: not in slots 0-1
  23+ E000              ;     (the ROM and esxDOS are there during a call) nor slot 7 (this page);
  24+ E000              ;   * file names end with a 0 byte.
  25+ E000              ;
  26+ E000              ; Every routine returns carry clear on success; carry set on failure with
  27+ E000              ; A = the esxDOS error code.  A file that was opened is closed again on
  28+ E000              ; any error in fh_load / fh_save.
  29+ E000              ;
  30+ E000              ; Routines:
  31+ E000              ;   fh_init      get the default drive (call once, before the others)
  32+ E000              ;   fh_open      HL = name, B = mode (FA_*)      -> A = handle
  33+ E000              ;   fh_close     A = handle
  34+ E000              ;   fh_read      A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read
  35+ E000              ;   fh_write     A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
  36+ E000              ;   fh_seek      A = handle, BCDE = offset, L = SEEK_* -> BCDE = position
  37+ E000              ;   fh_size      A = handle                      -> BCDE = file size
  38+ E000              ;   fh_load      HL = name, DE = address, BC = most bytes -> BC = bytes read
  39+ E000              ;   fh_save      HL = name, DE = address, BC = length (created / replaced)
  40+ E000              ;   fh_exists    HL = name -> carry clear if the file exists
  41+ E000              ;   fh_delete    HL = name
  42+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  43+ E000
  44+ E000              ; esxDOS function codes (the byte after RST $08)
  45+ E000              M_GETSETDRV     equ $89             ; A = 0: get the default drive
  46+ E000              F_OPEN          equ $9A
  47+ E000              F_CLOSE         equ $9B
  48+ E000              F_READ          equ $9D
  49+ E000              F_WRITE         equ $9E
  50+ E000              F_SEEK          equ $9F
  51+ E000              F_FSTAT         equ $A1
  52+ E000              F_UNLINK        equ $AD
  53+ E000
  54+ E000              ; F_OPEN modes (B)
  55+ E000              FA_READ         equ $01             ; read
  56+ E000              FA_WRITE        equ $02             ; write
  57+ E000              FA_OPEN_EX      equ $00             ; open an existing file only
  58+ E000              FA_OPEN_AL      equ $08             ; open, or create if it doesn't exist
  59+ E000              FA_CREATE_NEW   equ $04             ; create, fail if it exists
  60+ E000              FA_CREATE_AL    equ $0C             ; create, replacing any existing file
  61+ E000              FA_OVERWRITE    equ FA_WRITE|FA_CREATE_AL   ; for saving a whole file
  62+ E000
  63+ E000              ; F_SEEK modes (L)
  64+ E000              SEEK_START      equ 0               ; from the start of the file
  65+ E000              SEEK_FWD        equ 1               ; forwards from the current position
  66+ E000              SEEK_BACK       equ 2               ; backwards from the current position
  67+ E000
  68+ E000              FSTAT_SIZE      equ 7               ; F_FSTAT buffer: file size, 4 bytes
  69+ E000              FSTAT_LEN       equ 11              ; F_FSTAT buffer length
  70+ E000
  71+ E000              ESX_DEFAULT     equ '*'             ; drive: the default drive
  72+ E000
  73+ E000              ; An esxDOS call: the ROM in at $0000-$3FFF for the RST $08, the game's
  74+ E000              ; pages back after.  Registers in and out are the function's own; flags
  75+ E000              ; and A come back from esxDOS (carry set = error, A = code).
  76+ E000                      MACRO ESXDOS fn
  77+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_in
  78+ E000 ~                    rst $08
  79+ E000 ~                    db fn
  80+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_out
  81+ E000                      ENDM
  82+ E000
  83+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  84+ E000              ; Get the default drive into fh_drive (else the '*' default is used)
  85+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  86+ E000              fh_init:
  87+ E000 AF                   xor a                           ; A = 0: get
  88+ E001                      ESXDOS M_GETSETDRV
  88+ E001 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
  88+ E004 CF          >        rst $08
  88+ E005 89          >        db M_GETSETDRV
  88+ E006 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
  89+ E009 D8                   ret c
  90+ E00A 32 16 E1             ld (fh_drive),a
  91+ E00D C9                   ret
  92+ E00E
  93+ E00E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  94+ E00E              ; HL -> file name, B = mode (FA_*) -> A = handle (also in fh_handle)
  95+ E00E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  96+ E00E              fh_open:
  97+ E00E DD E5                push ix
  98+ E010 E5                   push hl
  99+ E011 DD E1                pop ix                          ; IX = HL = the name (both
 100+ E013 3A 16 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)                 ; conventions: programs, dot
 101+ E016                      ESXDOS F_OPEN                   ; commands)
 101+ E016 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 101+ E019 CF          >        rst $08
 101+ E01A 9A          >        db F_OPEN
 101+ E01B CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 102+ E01E DD E1                pop ix
 103+ E020 D8                   ret c
 104+ E021 32 17 E1             ld (fh_handle),a
 105+ E024 C9                   ret
 106+ E025
 107+ E025              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 108+ E025              ; A = handle: close it
 109+ E025              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 110+ E025              fh_close:
 111+ E025                      ESXDOS F_CLOSE
 111+ E025 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 111+ E028 CF          >        rst $08
 111+ E029 9B          >        db F_CLOSE
 111+ E02A CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 112+ E02D C9                   ret
 113+ E02E
 114+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 115+ E02E              ; A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read (fewer at the end
 116+ E02E              ; of the file)
 117+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 118+ E02E              fh_read:
 119+ E02E DD E5                push ix
 120+ E030 E5                   push hl
 121+ E031 DD E1                pop ix
 122+ E033                      ESXDOS F_READ
 122+ E033 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 122+ E036 CF          >        rst $08
 122+ E037 9D          >        db F_READ
 122+ E038 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 123+ E03B DD E1                pop ix
 124+ E03D C9                   ret
 125+ E03E
 126+ E03E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 127+ E03E              ; A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
 128+ E03E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 129+ E03E              fh_write:
 130+ E03E DD E5                push ix
 131+ E040 E5                   push hl
 132+ E041 DD E1                pop ix
 133+ E043                      ESXDOS F_WRITE
 133+ E043 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 133+ E046 CF          >        rst $08
 133+ E047 9E          >        db F_WRITE
 133+ E048 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 134+ E04B DD E1                pop ix
 135+ E04D C9                   ret
 136+ E04E
 137+ E04E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 138+ E04E              ; A = handle, BCDE = offset (32-bit), L = mode (SEEK_*) -> BCDE = position
 139+ E04E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 140+ E04E              fh_seek:
 141+ E04E DD E5                push ix
 142+ E050 E5                   push hl
 143+ E051 E5                   push hl
 144+ E052 DD E1                pop ix                          ; mode in IXL (programs) and L
 145+ E054                      ESXDOS F_SEEK
 145+ E054 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 145+ E057 CF          >        rst $08
 145+ E058 9F          >        db F_SEEK
 145+ E059 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 146+ E05C E1                   pop hl
 147+ E05D DD E1                pop ix
 148+ E05F C9                   ret
 149+ E060
 150+ E060              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 151+ E060              ; A = handle -> BCDE = file size (32-bit)
 152+ E060              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 153+ E060              fh_size:
 154+ E060 DD E5                push ix
 155+ E062 E5                   push hl
 156+ E063 21 1B E1             ld hl,fh_stat
 157+ E066 E5                   push hl
 158+ E067 DD E1                pop ix
 159+ E069                      ESXDOS F_FSTAT
 159+ E069 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 159+ E06C CF          >        rst $08
 159+ E06D A1          >        db F_FSTAT
 159+ E06E CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 160+ E071 38 0A                jr c,.x
 161+ E073 2A 22 E1             ld hl,(fh_stat+FSTAT_SIZE)
 162+ E076 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; DE = low word
 163+ E077 2A 24 E1             ld hl,(fh_stat+FSTAT_SIZE+2)
 164+ E07A 44                   ld b,h                          ; BC = high word
 165+ E07B 4D                   ld c,l
 166+ E07C B7                   or a
 167+ E07D E1           .x:     pop hl
 168+ E07E DD E1                pop ix
 169+ E080 C9                   ret
 170+ E081
 171+ E081              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 172+ E081              ; Load a file: HL -> name, DE = address, BC = most bytes to read
 173+ E081              ; -> BC = bytes read.  The file is opened, read and closed.
 174+ E081              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 175+ E081              fh_load:
 176+ E081 D5                   push de
 177+ E082 C5                   push bc
 178+ E083 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 179+ E085 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 180+ E088 C1                   pop bc
 181+ E089 E1                   pop hl                          ; HL = address
 182+ E08A D8                   ret c                           ; couldn't open (A = error)
 183+ E08B CD 2E E0             call fh_read
 184+ E08E 18 0D                jr fh_done                      ; close it, keeping any error
 185+ E090
 186+ E090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 187+ E090              ; Save a file: HL -> name, DE = address, BC = length.  The file is created,
 188+ E090              ; replacing any file of that name.
 189+ E090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ E090              fh_save:
 191+ E090 D5                   push de
 192+ E091 C5                   push bc
 193+ E092 06 0E                ld b,FA_OVERWRITE
 194+ E094 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 195+ E097 C1                   pop bc
 196+ E098 E1                   pop hl
 197+ E099 D8                   ret c
 198+ E09A CD 3E E0             call fh_write
 199+ E09D                      ; fall through
 200+ E09D
 201+ E09D              ; After a read / write on fh_handle: close the file.  Carry and A as from
 202+ E09D              ; that read / write if it failed, else as from the close.
 203+ E09D              fh_done:
 204+ E09D F5                   push af
 205+ E09E 3A 17 E1             ld a,(fh_handle)
 206+ E0A1 CD 25 E0             call fh_close
 207+ E0A4 38 02                jr c,.cerr
 208+ E0A6 F1                   pop af                          ; the read / write's result
 209+ E0A7 C9                   ret
 210+ E0A8 E1           .cerr:  pop hl                          ; the close failed: if the read /
 211+ E0A9 CB 45                bit 0,l                         ; write had already failed, report
 212+ E0AB 28 01                jr z,.ce                        ; that, else the close's error
 213+ E0AD 7C                   ld a,h
 214+ E0AE 37           .ce:    scf
 215+ E0AF C9                   ret
 216+ E0B0
 217+ E0B0              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 218+ E0B0              ; HL -> name: carry clear if the file exists (it can be opened to read)
 219+ E0B0              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 220+ E0B0              fh_exists:
 221+ E0B0 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 222+ E0B2 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 223+ E0B5 D8                   ret c
 224+ E0B6 C3 25 E0             jp fh_close
 225+ E0B9
 226+ E0B9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 227+ E0B9              ; HL -> name: delete the file
 228+ E0B9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 229+ E0B9              fh_delete:
 230+ E0B9 DD E5                push ix
 231+ E0BB E5                   push hl
 232+ E0BC DD E1                pop ix
 233+ E0BE 3A 16 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)
 234+ E0C1                      ESXDOS F_UNLINK
 234+ E0C1 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 234+ E0C4 CF          >        rst $08
 234+ E0C5 AD          >        db F_UNLINK
 234+ E0C6 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 235+ E0C9 DD E1                pop ix
 236+ E0CB C9                   ret
 237+ E0CC
 238+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 239+ E0CC              ; Page the ROM into slots 0 and 1 for RST $08, remembering the game's pages
 240+ E0CC              ; (fh_rom_in), and put them back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off in
 241+ E0CC              ; between (the ROM covers the interrupt routine, slot 1), and back on after
 242+ E0CC              ; if they were on before.  Both keep every register and flag.
 243+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 244+ E0CC              fh_rom_in:
 245+ E0CC F5                   push af
 246+ E0CD ED 57                ld a,i                          ; P/V: interrupts on (IFF2)
 247+ E0CF F3                   di
 248+ E0D0 3E 00                ld a,0
 249+ E0D2 E2 D6 E0             jp po,.off
 250+ E0D5 3C                   inc a
 251+ E0D6 32 1A E1     .off:   ld (fh_ints),a
 252+ E0D9 C5                   push bc
 253+ E0DA 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 254+ E0DD 3E 50                ld a,MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER        ; slot 0's page now
 255+ E0DF ED 79                out (c),a
 256+ E0E1 04                   inc b
 257+ E0E2 ED 78                in a,(c)
 258+ E0E4 32 18 E1             ld (fh_mmu0),a
 259+ E0E7 05                   dec b
 260+ E0E8 3E 51                ld a,MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER        ; slot 1's
 261+ E0EA ED 79                out (c),a
 262+ E0EC 04                   inc b
 263+ E0ED ED 78                in a,(c)
 264+ E0EF 32 19 E1             ld (fh_mmu1),a
 265+ E0F2 ED 91 50 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 266+ E0F6 ED 91 51 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 267+ E0FA C1                   pop bc
 268+ E0FB F1                   pop af
 269+ E0FC C9                   ret
 270+ E0FD
 271+ E0FD              fh_rom_out:
 272+ E0FD F3                   di                              ; (in case esxDOS enabled them)
 273+ E0FE F5                   push af
 274+ E0FF 3A 18 E1             ld a,(fh_mmu0)
 275+ E102 ED 92 50             nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,a
 276+ E105 3A 19 E1             ld a,(fh_mmu1)
 277+ E108 ED 92 51             nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,a
 278+ E10B 3A 1A E1             ld a,(fh_ints)
 279+ E10E B7                   or a
 280+ E10F 28 03                jr z,.off
 281+ E111 F1                   pop af
 282+ E112 FB                   ei                              ; on again, as they were
 283+ E113 C9                   ret
 284+ E114 F1           .off:   pop af
 285+ E115 C9                   ret
 286+ E116
 287+ E116              ;==============================================================================
 288+ E116              ; File handler data
 289+ E116              ;==============================================================================
 290+ E116 2A           fh_drive:   db ESX_DEFAULT              ; drive for F_OPEN (fh_init)
 291+ E117 00           fh_handle:  db 0                        ; the last file opened
 292+ E118 00           fh_mmu0:    db 0                        ; the game's slot 0 / 1 pages during
 293+ E119 00           fh_mmu1:    db 0                        ; an esxDOS call
 294+ E11A 00           fh_ints:    db 0                        ; 1: interrupts were on before it
 295+ E11B 00 00 00...  fh_stat:    ds FSTAT_LEN                ; F_FSTAT buffer (fh_size)

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - audio (8K page PAGE_AUDIO, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in
   3+ E000              ; with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Sound devices: the Next's TurboSound, three AY-3-8912 chips.  initgame
   6+ E000              ; (initialise.asm) has already set the chip mode to AY (NextReg $06),
   7+ E000              ; turned TurboSound and the internal speaker on (NextReg $08) and the AY
   8+ E000              ; outputs to stereo (NextReg $09).  init_audio then sets every chip to a
   9+ E000              ; known, silent state (at start-up, and on every menu screen: menu_clear).
  10+ E000              ; AY 1 is the VTOL's engines: engine_start here, then the interrupt routine
  11+ E000              ; plays them (engine_tick, interrupts.asm).  AY 2 is the weapons' sound
  12+ E000              ; effects, AY 3 explosions: the game asks for one with ld a,SFX_n / ld
  13+ E000              ; (sfx_req),a (AY 2), ld (sfx2_req),a (AY 3's A and B) or ld (sfx3_req),a
  14+ E000              ; (AY 3's C), and the interrupt plays it (sfx_tick).  (Music would need AY 3
  15+ E000              ; back.)  The interrupt writes the AY ports while eng_on is 1,
  16+ E000              ; so code here writes them only with eng_on 0 (or interrupts off).
  17+ E000              ;
  18+ E000              ; TurboSound ports:
  19+ E000              ;   $FFFD write %1LR111cc: select AY chip cc (AY_CHIP_1..3) with its left
  20+ E000              ;         (L) and right (R) outputs on;
  21+ E000              ;         any value 0..15: select that register of the selected chip
  22+ E000              ;   $BFFD write: the value of the selected register
  23+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  24+ E000
  25+ E000              AY_CTRL_PORT    equ $FFFD           ; chip / register select
  26+ E000              AY_DATA_PORT    equ $BFFD           ; register value
  27+ E000
  28+ E000              ; Chip select ($FFFD): AY_SELECT | AY_LEFT | AY_RIGHT | AY_CHIP_n
  29+ E000              AY_SELECT       equ %10011100       ; bit 7 and bits 4-2 must be set
  30+ E000              AY_LEFT         equ %01000000       ; left output on
  31+ E000              AY_RIGHT        equ %00100000       ; right output on
  32+ E000              AY_CHIP_1       equ %11
  33+ E000              AY_CHIP_2       equ %10
  34+ E000              AY_CHIP_3       equ %01
  35+ E000
  36+ E000              ; AY registers
  37+ E000              AY_TONE_A       equ 0               ; channel A tone period: fine, coarse (4)
  38+ E000              AY_TONE_B       equ 2
  39+ E000              AY_TONE_C       equ 4
  40+ E000              AY_NOISE        equ 6               ; noise period (5 bits)
  41+ E000              AY_MIXER        equ 7               ; tone / noise enable, 0 = on:
  42+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_A    equ %00000001       ;   bits 0-2 tone A-C off,
  43+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_B    equ %00000010
  44+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_C    equ %00000100
  45+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_A   equ %00001000       ;   bits 3-5 noise A-C off
  46+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_B   equ %00010000
  47+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_C   equ %00100000
  48+ E000              AY_VOL_A        equ 8               ; amplitude 0-15 (bit 4: use envelope)
  49+ E000              AY_VOL_B        equ 9
  50+ E000              AY_VOL_C        equ 10
  51+ E000              AY_ENV_FINE     equ 11              ; envelope period
  52+ E000              AY_ENV_COARSE   equ 12
  53+ E000              AY_ENV_SHAPE    equ 13              ; envelope shape
  54+ E000              AY_REGS         equ 14
  55+ E000

  57+ E000              AY_MIXER_INIT   equ AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  58+ E000                                                  ; tones on, noise off
  59+ E000
  60+ E000              ; The engines (AY 1): jet turbines, from n = |speed| (at least 1: the idle,
  61+ E000              ; at zero throttle, sounds as speed 1), 1..SPEED_MAX
  62+ E000              ENG_MIXER       equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C

  64+ E000              ENG_NOISE0      equ 29              ; A, the roar: noise period 29 - n*13/16
  65+ E000              ENG_NOISE_MUL   equ 13              ;   (29 at idle, a rumble; 7 flat out, a hiss)
  66+ E000              ENG_ROAR_VOL0   equ 4               ;   volume 4 + n*7/32 (4..10)

  70+ E000              ENG_VOL_MUL     equ 7               ; the volumes rise by n*7/32 (0..6)
  71+ E000              ENG_DETUNE      equ 2               ; C, the same whine 2 periods lower: the
  72+ E000              ENG_SHIMMER_VOL equ 2               ;   two beat (the turbines' shimmer), 2 quieter

 150+ E03C 1E 0D                ld e,AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD

 153+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 154+ E041              ; The VTOL's engines: jet turbines, not rotors, so a steady roar and whine
 155+ E041              ; rather than a chop.  AY 1, all three channels, kept for them.  They never
 156+ E041              ; stop in play: at zero throttle they idle, as at speed 1.  The interrupt
 157+ E041              ; routine plays them, 50 times a second (engine_tick, interrupts.asm): the
 158+ E041              ; sound's speed spools towards the VTOL's, so pitch and volume rise and fall
 159+ E041              ; smoothly.  (The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is
 160+ E041              ; 109375/P Hz.)
 161+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 162+ E041              ; Start of each level (next_level): AY 1's mixer for the engines, the sound's
 163+ E041              ; speed 0 (they spool up to the idle), and the interrupt playing them
 164+ E041              engine_start:
 165+ E041 AF                   xor a
 166+ E042 32 68 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; (the interrupt off AY 1 meanwhile)
 167+ E045 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 168+ E048 22 73 3C             ld (eng_cur),hl
 169+ E04B 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 170+ E04D CD 5D E0             call ay_select
 171+ E050 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 172+ E052 1E 31                ld e,ENG_MIXER
 173+ E054 CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 174+ E057 3E 01                ld a,1
 175+ E059 32 68 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; the interrupt plays them now
 176+ E05C C9                   ret
 177+ E05D
 178+ E05D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 179+ E05D              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it, with both outputs on
 180+ E05D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 181+ E05D              ay_select:
 182+ E05D F6 FC                or AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT
 183+ E05F 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 184+ E062 ED 79                out (c),a
 185+ E064 C9                   ret
 186+ E065
 187+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 188+ E065              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected chip.  Keeps D, E, HL.
 189+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ E065              ay_write:
 191+ E065 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 192+ E068 ED 79                out (c),a
 193+ E06A 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 194+ E06C ED 59                out (c),e
 195+ E06E C9                   ret

 427+ C31B              ; The VTOL has been destroyed (vtol_dead): the controls do nothing.  It
 428+ C31B              ; spins DEAD_SPIN a frame and falls, a unit a frame faster each frame (up
 429+ C31B              ; to DEAD_FALL_MAX), until it hits the ground under it (floor_y: the road,
 430+ C31B              ; or the highest roof under its footprint).  Once down it lies still for
 431+ C31B              ; DEAD_PAUSE frames, then sets game_over (main_loop: the GAME OVER screen,
 432+ C31B              ; then the main menu).
 433+ C31B              vtol_wreck:

 453+ C343 30 03                jr nc,.y
 454+ C345 21 00 00             ld hl,0

 456+ C349 CD AD AA             call floor_y                    ; HL = the ground under it
 457+ C34C EB                   ex de,hl
 458+ C34D E1                   pop hl
 459+ C34E B7                   or a
 460+ C34F ED 52                sbc hl,de
 461+ C351 19                   add hl,de
 462+ C352 30 06                jr nc,.set                      ; still above it
 463+ C354 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; hit the ground: on it
 464+ C355 3E 01                ld a,1
 465+ C357 32 7D AF             ld (dead_down),a
 466+ C35A 22 64 AF     .set:   ld (cam_y),hl
 467+ C35D C9                   ret

 470+ C362 C0                   ret nz
 471+ C363 3E 01                ld a,1

 473+ C368 C9                   ret
 474+ C369
 475+ C369              ; One damping step: move the signed 8.8 pitch (pitch_frac/pitch) towards 0
 476+ C369              ; by max(PDAMP_MIN, |whole pitch| * PDAMP_K), stopping exactly at 0.
 477+ C369              ; Calculated rather than looked up: the Z80N MUL makes it as quick as a
 478+ C369              ; table, and the curve stays editable through the two equates.
 479+ C369              pitch_damp:
 480+ C369 2A 68 AF             ld hl,(pitch_frac)
 481+ C36C 7C                   ld a,h
 482+ C36D B5                   or l
 483+ C36E C8                   ret z                           ; already level
 484+ C36F 7C                   ld a,h
 485+ C370 F5                   push af                         ; sign
 486+ C371 CD 20 AF             call abs_hl
 487+ C374 54                   ld d,h                          ; whole part of |pitch|
 488+ C375 1E 00                ld e,PDAMP_K
 489+ C377 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = step
 490+ C379 7A                   ld a,d
 491+ C37A B7                   or a
 492+ C37B 20 08                jr nz,.sub
 493+ C37D 7B                   ld a,e
 494+ C37E FE 80                cp PDAMP_MIN
 495+ C380 30 03                jr nc,.sub
 496+ C382 11 80 00             ld de,PDAMP_MIN
 497+ C385 B7           .sub:   or a
 498+ C386 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 499+ C388 30 03                jr nc,.sgn
 500+ C38A 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; would pass level: stop at 0
 501+ C38D F1           .sgn:   pop af
 502+ C38E 17                   rla                             ; carry = was nose down
 503+ C38F DC 19 AF             call c,neg_hl
 504+ C392 22 68 AF             ld (pitch_frac),hl
 505+ C395 C9                   ret

# file opened: weapons.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - weapons page (8K page PAGE_WEAPONS, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Player weapons.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS
   5+ C000              ; (the keys page in slot 7) after
   6+ C000              ; the frame is set up (it uses sin_y/cos_y/sin_p/cos_p) and the zombies have
   7+ C000              ; moved.  Bullet state lives in the resident `bullets` table so that the city
   8+ C000              ; page can draw the tracers (draw_bullets).
   9+ C000              ;
  10+ C000              ; Keys 1-5 select the weapon slot that SPACE fires (wpn_sel: 1 = the centre
  11+ C000              ; slot, 2-5 = the wing pylons).  An empty slot isn't selected: the HUD
  12+ C000              ; flashes it instead (wflash_slot / wflash_t).  What is fitted where is set
  13+ C000              ; on the load-out screen between levels (loadout.asm).
  14+ C000              ;
  15+ C000              ; Machine gun (WPN_GUN, the centre slot): hold SPACE to fire one round every
  16+ C000              ; GUN_INTERVAL frames.  Rounds leave the ship's centre line 0.5 m below the
  17+ C000              ; camera and fly straight along the view direction at 500 m/s until they hit
  18+ C000              ; something.
  19+ C000              ;
  20+ C000              ; Collision, every frame for every round in flight: the path from its last
  21+ C000              ; position to its new one (BULLET_STEP long) is walked cell by cell through
  22+ C000              ; the city grid, in order (a 2D DDA on the horizontal distance s along the
  23+ C000              ; path).  The first thing met ends the path:
  24+ C000              ;   * a building cell: hit where the path enters the cell if it is below the
  25+ C000              ;     roof there (a wall), otherwise where it drops below the roof (the roof);
  26+ C000              ;   * a street cell marked as holding zombies (CELL_ZOMBIE): those in it, each a box
  27+ C000              ;     0.5 m wide and 2 m tall, nearest along the path first;
  28+ C000              ;   * the ground, where the path reaches height 0;
  29+ C000              ;   * leaving the GRID x GRID map: the round is gone.
  30+ C000              ; A round that hits is drawn once at the impact point, then freed.  A zombie
  31+ C000              ; that is hit loses B_DMG hit points; at 0 it is killed (its map blip
  32+ C000              ; removed, its record made inactive).  A rocket also bursts (rocket_blast).
  33+ C000              ;
  34+ C000              ; Rocket pod (WPN_ROCKETS, a wing pylon, ROCKET_SHOTS rockets): rockets are
  35+ C000              ; rounds too (B_KIND = BK_ROCKET), at 150 m/s and drawn as a short white
  36+ C000              ; streak with a yellow trail.  Wherever one stops (a building, the ground,
  37+ C000              ; a zombie) rocket_blast does BLAST_DMG to every zombie, human and base tile
  38+ C000              ; within BLAST_R on each axis, and sprays BLAST_PARTS orange particles.
  39+ C000              ;
  40+ C000              ; Autocannon (WPN_AUTOCANNON, a wing pylon, AUTOCANNON_SHOTS shells): the
  41+ C000              ; machine gun's rounds (B_KIND = BK_AUTOCANNON, drawn as tracers) one every
  42+ C000              ; AUTOCANNON_INTERVAL frames; each bursts where it stops: AUTOCANNON_DMG
  43+ C000              ; within AUTOCANNON_R (3 m) on each axis, AUTOCANNON_PARTS particles.
  44+ C000              ;
  45+ C000              ; Proximity cannon (WPN_PROX, a wing pylon, PROX_SHOTS shells): the
  46+ C000              ; autocannon (B_KIND = BK_PROX), its shells also bursting when they pass within
  47+ C000              ; PROX_R (2 m) of a monster (b_pr widens the monster hit boxes,
  48+ C000              ; cell_zombies); the burst does PROX_DMG within PROX_R on each axis.
  49+ C000              ;
  50+ C000              ; Missile pod (WPN_MISSILE, a wing pylon, MISSILE_SHOTS missiles): as the
  51+ C000              ; rockets (B_KIND = BK_MISSILE, drawn the same) at half the speed; the burst
  52+ C000              ; does MISSILE_DMG within MISSILE_R (1.0 tile) on each axis, and sprays
  53+ C000              ; MISSILE_PARTS particles.  Guided: one fires only with a target locked
  54+ C000              ; (lock_update: the reticule), and turns towards it (msl_steer) at
  55+ C000              ; MISSILE_TURN a frame until it is more than LOCK_RANGE away.
  56+ C000              ;
  57+ C000              ; Damage: each round carries its damage (B_DMG): machine gun GUN_DMG, chain
  58+ C000              ; gun CHAIN_DMG, the laser LASER_DMG a beam frame, a rocket none directly
  59+ C000              ; (only its blast).  A zombie dies when its hit points (+18) run out.
  60+ C000              ;
  61+ C000              ; Positions are world units (1 tile = 20 m = 256 units, 1 m = 12.8).  Along the path,
  62+ C000              ; x = x0 + s*sinY, z = z0 + s*cosY and y = y0 + s*slope, with sinY/cosY the
  63+ C000              ; S7.8 heading at firing and slope = tan(pitch) in S7.8.
  64+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  65+ C000

 288+ C1CC              round_spread:
 289+ C1CC 32 C0 D6             ld (rs_dev),a
 290+ C1CF CD FB 26             call zrand                      ; (zombie page)
 291+ C1D2 E5                   push hl
 292+ C1D3 7D                   ld a,l
 293+ C1D4 CD 85 C8             call dev_n                      ; sideways
 294+ C1D7 CD EF C1             call round_turn
 295+ C1DA E1                   pop hl                          ; up/down: slope (tan) +/- d/256
 296+ C1DB 7C                   ld a,h
 297+ C1DC CD 85 C8             call dev_n
 298+ C1DF DD 6E 0B             ld l,(ix+B_SLOPE)
 299+ C1E2 DD 66 0C             ld h,(ix+B_SLOPE+1)
 300+ C1E5 CD 94 C8             call add_sa
 301+ C1E8 DD 75 0B             ld (ix+B_SLOPE),l
 302+ C1EB DD 74 0C             ld (ix+B_SLOPE+1),h
 303+ C1EE C9                   ret
 304+ C1EF
 305+ C1EF              ; Round IX's heading turned A steps (1/256 rad; + right): rotate (sin, cos)
 306+ C1EF              round_turn:

 308+ C1F0 C8                   ret z

 310+ C1F2 2E 00                ld l,0
 311+ C1F4 22 84 D6             ld (cg_d),hl                    ; d * 256
 312+ C1F7 DD 5E 09             ld e,(ix+B_COS)                 ; sin += round(d * cos / 256)
 313+ C1FA DD 56 0A             ld d,(ix+B_COS+1)
 314+ C1FD CD 78 C8             call dmul
 315+ C200 22 86 D6             ld (cg_s),hl
 316+ C203 2A 84 D6             ld hl,(cg_d)                    ; cos -= round(d * sin / 256)
 317+ C206 DD 5E 07             ld e,(ix+B_SIN)
 318+ C209 DD 56 08             ld d,(ix+B_SIN+1)
 319+ C20C CD 78 C8             call dmul
 320+ C20F EB                   ex de,hl
 321+ C210 DD 6E 09             ld l,(ix+B_COS)
 322+ C213 DD 66 0A             ld h,(ix+B_COS+1)
 323+ C216 B7                   or a
 324+ C217 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 325+ C219 DD 75 09             ld (ix+B_COS),l
 326+ C21C DD 74 0A             ld (ix+B_COS+1),h
 327+ C21F DD 6E 07             ld l,(ix+B_SIN)
 328+ C222 DD 66 08             ld h,(ix+B_SIN+1)
 329+ C225 ED 5B 86 D6          ld de,(cg_s)
 330+ C229 19                   add hl,de
 331+ C22A DD 75 07             ld (ix+B_SIN),l
 332+ C22D DD 74 08             ld (ix+B_SIN+1),h
 333+ C230 C9                   ret
 334+ C231
 335+ C231              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 336+ C231              ; Aim assist, for a centre slot round IX just spawned, pointing where the gun
 337+ C231              ; does: the nearest monster drawn last frame (a monster behind a building
 338+ C231              ; isn't: bit 1 of +31) with its middle within AIM_DEV steps of the path, or
 339+ C231              ; its box on the path already.  The round turns to its middle, at most
 340+ C231              ; AIM_DEV steps sideways and AIM_DEV up or down: aa_d and aa_ds, kept for the
 341+ C231              ; frame's shots (aim_apply) and the sight.  Only the round: the view doesn't
 342+ C231              ; move.  A chain gun's spread goes on top.
 343+ C231              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 344+ C231
 345+ C231              ; Once a frame, before the guns fire (lock_update has put the drawn marks in
 346+ C231              ; bit 1): with a gun in the centre slot, the assist for a round from the
 347+ C231              ; muzzle (aa_probe, not one in flight), and the centre crosshair moved to
 348+ C231              ; where its rounds go: sight_ax, sight_ay.  gun_aim put them on the gun's
 349+ C231              ; line, and nothing turns it unless this runs.
 350+ C231              aim_probe:

 352+ C232 32 8A D6             ld (aa_d),a

 355+ C23B FE 00                cp WPN_CENTRE
 356+ C23D C0                   ret nz
 357+ C23E CD 18 CD             call sel_slot

 359+ C242 B7                   or a
 360+ C243 C8                   ret z                           ; (an empty slot)

 368+ C258 32 E3 AF             ld (sight_ax),a
 369+ C25B 3A 8B D6             ld a,(aa_ds)                    ; up: the slope's change, likewise
 370+ C25E CB 2F                sra a
 371+ C260 ED 44                neg
 372+ C262 4F                   ld c,a
 373+ C263 3A E1 AF             ld a,(sight_y)
 374+ C266 81                   add a,c
 375+ C267 FE 06                cp SIGHT_MARGIN

 377+ C26B 3E 06                ld a,SIGHT_MARGIN
 378+ C26D FE 7A        .lo:    cp VIEW_H-SIGHT_MARGIN

 380+ C271 3E 79                ld a,VIEW_H-SIGHT_MARGIN-1
 381+ C273 32 E4 AF     .hi:    ld (sight_ay),a
 382+ C276 C9                   ret
 383+ C277                      ASSERT AIM_DEV/2 < SIGHT_MARGIN ; (sight_y is within the view)
 384+ C277
 385+ C277              ; Round IX (a centre slot round just spawned): the frame's turn (aim_probe)
 386+ C277              aim_apply:

 394+ C28C DD 74 0C             ld (ix+B_SLOPE+1),h
 395+ C28F C9                   ret

 456+ C30D CD 3D D6             call udiv24

 458+ C311 17                   rla
 459+ C312 DC 19 AF             call c,neg_hl
 460+ C315 DD 5E 0B             ld e,(ix+B_SLOPE)
 461+ C318 DD 56 0C             ld d,(ix+B_SLOPE+1)
 462+ C31B B7                   or a
 463+ C31C ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; the change, at most AIM_DEV each way
 464+ C31E 01 08 00             ld bc,AIM_DEV

 482+ C33F              ; Monster IY, in play: the one to aim at, so far?  Ahead of round IX, nearer
 483+ C33F              ; than the last, within AIM_DEV (or its box) of the path each way
 484+ C33F              aa_try:

 503+ C36F E5                   push hl

 505+ C373 DD 5E 09             ld e,(ix+B_COS)
 506+ C376 DD 56 0A             ld d,(ix+B_COS+1)

 508+ C37C D1                   pop de

 510+ C37E CB 7C                bit 7,h
 511+ C380 C0                   ret nz                          ; behind
 512+ C381 11 10 00             ld de,NEAR

 516+ C388 19                   add hl,de

 521+ C391 19                   add hl,de
 522+ C392 22 B7 D6             ld (aa_tl),hl
 523+ C395 11 08 00             ld de,AIM_DEV                   ; the room each way: along * AIM_DEV
 524+ C398 CD 25 AF             call fmul                       ; / 256
 525+ C39B 22 BD D6             ld (aa_lim),hl
 526+ C39E 2A B3 D6             ld hl,(aa_rx)                   ; across = rx cos - rz sin
 527+ C3A1 DD 5E 09             ld e,(ix+B_COS)
 528+ C3A4 DD 56 0A             ld d,(ix+B_COS+1)

 530+ C3AA E5                   push hl
 531+ C3AB 2A B5 D6             ld hl,(aa_rz)

 544+ C3C8 FD 7E 0F             ld a,(iy+15)                    ; half its height: a ghoul half as

 552+ C3D9 79           .hh:    ld a,c

 554+ C3DD FD 6E 15             ld l,(iy+21)                    ; its middle, from the muzzle
 555+ C3E0 FD 66 16             ld h,(iy+22)

 590+ C42C              ; Round IX (just spawned) and its muzzle moved HL units to the right of the

 616+ C46A
 617+ C46A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 618+ C46A              ; The missile lock, each frame in flight.  With the missile pod selected the
 619+ C46A              ; reticule is shown (ret_on).  Searching (lock_state 0), it wanders the view.
 620+ C46A              ; A monster drawn last frame (fig_seen: +31) within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL
 621+ C46A              ; along x and z, the nearest, becomes the target (lock_tgt): locking (1),
 622+ C46A              ; the reticule moves to where it was drawn (+32, +33) at RET_STEP pixels a
 623+ C46A              ; frame, and after LOCK_TIME frames on it (within LOCK_NEAR) the target is
 624+ C46A              ; locked (2): the lock tone, and the reticule stays on it.  The target lost
 625+ C46A              ; (killed, out of view, out of range) it searches again.  Then the drawn
 626+ C46A              ; marks are cleared for this frame's drawing.
 627+ C46A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 628+ C46A              lock_update:
 629+ C46A CD 18 CD             call sel_slot
 630+ C46D 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 631+ C46E FE 05                cp WPN_MISSILE
 632+ C470 C2 FD C4             jp nz,lock_off
 633+ C473 3E 01                ld a,1
 634+ C475 32 E7 AF             ld (ret_on),a
 635+ C478 3A EB AF             ld a,(lock_tgt)
 636+ C47B FE FF                cp $FF
 637+ C47D 28 0B                jr z,.find
 638+ C47F CD 32 C5             call lk_rec
 639+ C482 CD 3E C5             call lk_valid
 640+ C485 30 1C                jr nc,.have
 641+ C487 CD 25 C5             call lk_lose                    ; the target lost
 642+ C48A CD 88 C5     .find:  call lk_nearest                 ; a new one?
 643+ C48D FE FF                cp $FF
 644+ C48F 28 42                jr z,.wander

 646+ C494 3E 01                ld a,1
 647+ C496 32 EA AF             ld (lock_state),a
 648+ C499 AF                   xor a
 649+ C49A 32 EC AF             ld (lock_t),a
 650+ C49D 3A EB AF             ld a,(lock_tgt)
 651+ C4A0 CD 32 C5             call lk_rec
 652+ C4A3 CD C4 C5     .have:  call lk_spot                    ; C, B = where it was drawn

 654+ C4A9 FE 02                cp 2
 655+ C4AB 20 0A                jr nz,.move
 656+ C4AD 79                   ld a,c                          ; locked: on it
 657+ C4AE 32 E8 AF             ld (ret_x),a
 658+ C4B1 78                   ld a,b
 659+ C4B2 32 E9 AF             ld (ret_y),a

 662+ C4B9 CD E5 C5             call ret_toward
 663+ C4BC 30 50                jr nc,lk_clear                  ; not on it yet
 664+ C4BE 21 EC AF             ld hl,lock_t
 665+ C4C1 34                   inc (hl)
 666+ C4C2 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 667+ C4C3 FE 1C                cp LOCK_TIME
 668+ C4C5 38 47                jr c,lk_clear
 669+ C4C7 3E 02                ld a,2                          ; locked
 670+ C4C9 32 EA AF             ld (lock_state),a
 671+ C4CC 3E 0D                ld a,SFX_LOCK
 672+ C4CE 32 69 3C             ld (sfx_req),a
 673+ C4D1 18 3B                jr lk_clear
 674+ C4D3              .wander:
 675+ C4D3 3A ED AF             ld a,(wnd_x)
 676+ C4D6 4F                   ld c,a
 677+ C4D7 3A EE AF             ld a,(wnd_y)
 678+ C4DA 47                   ld b,a
 679+ C4DB 1E 02                ld e,RET_WANDER
 680+ C4DD CD E5 C5             call ret_toward
 681+ C4E0 30 2C                jr nc,lk_clear
 682+ C4E2 CD FB 26             call zrand                      ; there: somewhere new, within
 683+ C4E5 55                   ld d,l                          ; RET_WANDER_R of the view's centre
 684+ C4E6 1E 51                ld e,2*RET_WANDER_R+1
 685+ C4E8 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; D = 0..2*RET_WANDER_R
 686+ C4EA 7A                   ld a,d
 687+ C4EB C6 58                add a,128-RET_WANDER_R
 688+ C4ED 32 ED AF             ld (wnd_x),a
 689+ C4F0 54                   ld d,h
 690+ C4F1 1E 51                ld e,2*RET_WANDER_R+1
 691+ C4F3 ED 30                mul d,e
 692+ C4F5 7A                   ld a,d
 693+ C4F6 C6 18                add a,VIEW_CY-RET_WANDER_R
 694+ C4F8 32 EE AF             ld (wnd_y),a
 695+ C4FB 18 11                jr lk_clear
 696+ C4FD                      ASSERT VIEW_CY-RET_WANDER_R >= RET_HALF && VIEW_CY+RET_WANDER_R < VIEW_H-RET_HALF
 697+ C4FD
 698+ C4FD              ; No lock, no reticule (another weapon, landed, destroyed)
 699+ C4FD              lock_off:
 700+ C4FD AF                   xor a
 701+ C4FE 32 E7 AF             ld (ret_on),a
 702+ C501 3E 80                ld a,128                        ; next time from the centre
 703+ C503 32 E8 AF             ld (ret_x),a
 704+ C506 3E 40                ld a,VIEW_CY
 705+ C508 32 E9 AF             ld (ret_y),a
 706+ C50B CD 25 C5             call lk_lose
 707+ C50E                      ; fall through
 708+ C50E
 709+ C50E              ; Every monster's drawn mark (+31): bit 0 cleared, what it was in bit 1 for
 710+ C50E              ; the guns, which fire after this (aim_assist)
 711+ C50E              lk_clear:
 712+ C50E FD 21 1B 2A          ld iy,zombies+31
 713+ C512 06 30                ld b,NMON
 714+ C514 11 22 00             ld de,ZREC
 715+ C517 FD 7E 00     .lp:    ld a,(iy+0)

 718+ C51D FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 719+ C520 FD 19                add iy,de
 720+ C522 10 F3                djnz .lp
 721+ C524 C9                   ret
 722+ C525
 723+ C525              ; No target: searching
 724+ C525              lk_lose:
 725+ C525 3E FF                ld a,$FF

1898+ CD22              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1899+ CD22              ; Landed (update_weapons): on the base pad, repair and reload.  The VTOL
1900+ CD22              ; gains 1 hit point every REPAIR_FRAMES frames up to VTOL_HP; each slot
1901+ CD22              ; whose weapon reloads (wpn_cfg, zpolice.asm: its full load and frames a
1902+ CD22              ; shot) gains a

1904+ CD22              ; each landing (svc_on), so a shot or hit point takes the whole interval.

1978+ CDA6              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1979+ CDA6              ; Pulse laser: SPACE held with the laser in the centre slot fires a beam for
1980+ CDA6              ; LASER_ON frames, then it cools for LASER_COOL frames.  Each beam frame the
1981+ CDA6              ; beam is traced from the muzzle along the current view direction (the round
1982+ CDA6              ; walk, LASER_RANGE long) to the first building, ground or zombie, killing a
1983+ CDA6              ; zombie it reaches.  It is kept in laser_rec as a round (state 3) whose
1984+ CDA6              ; path runs from the muzzle to where the beam stops; draw_bullets clips it
1985+ CDA6              ; to the view, so it rises from the bottom edge of the screen.
1986+ CDA6              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1987+ CDA6              laser_update:
1988+ CDA6 3A 7C D6             ld a,(las_on)
1989+ CDA9 B7                   or a
1990+ CDAA 20 25                jr nz,.beam
1991+ CDAC 32 76 B3             ld (laser_rec+B_STATE),a        ; no beam this frame
1992+ CDAF 3A 7D D6             ld a,(las_cool)
1993+ CDB2 B7                   or a

2007+ CDCC 3E 02                ld a,SFX_LASER                  ; a new pulse: its zap
2008+ CDCE 32 69 3C             ld (sfx_req),a
2009+ CDD1 21 7C D6     .beam:  ld hl,las_on

2011+ CDD5 20 05                jr nz,.on
2012+ CDD7 3E 08                ld a,LASER_COOL                 ; last beam frame: cool down next
2013+ CDD9 32 7D D6             ld (las_cool),a
2014+ CDDC DD 21 76 B3  .on:    ld ix,laser_rec
2015+ CDE0 21 00 06             ld hl,LASER_RANGE

2027+ CDFA              ; Particles (pool `particles`, drawn by draw_particles): zombie bursts and

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - main menu (8K page PAGE_MENU, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Shown after start-up.  Layer 2 is hidden and the menu is drawn on the ULA
   5+ C000              ; screen with opaque paper.  Every frame it advances the random number
   6+ C000              ; generator (zrand), so the game doesn't start from the same seed each time
   7+ C000              ; (the wait for a key press varies), then reads the keys:
   8+ C000              ;   1  New game   -> newGame (zpolice.asm): level 1
   9+ C000              ;   2  Continue   -> the save game (made by save and quit, from the pause:
  10+ C000              ;                 game_pause), its level at its wave (load_save,
  11+ C000              ;                 continue_game, zpolice.asm); NO SAVED GAME if there's none
  12+ C000              ;   9  Redefine keys -> keydef_screen (keydef.asm)
  13+ C000              ; game_over_screen (the landing pad destroyed) shows GAME OVER until SPACE
  14+ C000              ; is pressed, then returns here.
  15+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  16+ C000
  17+ C000

 164+ C13B              ; Salvage, at the end of a level: each human saved this level (saved) adds
 165+ C13B              ; a salvage point (salvage_points).  Every point total in salvage_tab that
 166+ C13B              ; the new total reaches (passed over from the old one) gives its rewards: a

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level loading (8K page PAGE_LEVEL, game logic: runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6; it pages the file handler, PAGE_FILE, into slot 7)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Each level is a file, ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL, naming its city, ZPDATA/CITYnn.ZPC
   6+ C000              ; (both made by gentables.py; the formats are described there).  A city is
   7+ C000              ; played for several levels.  load_level reads both:
   8+ C000              ;   * the level record into level_cur (levels.asm): city name, zombie and
   9+ C000              ;     wave counts, the draw distance, ...;
  10+ C000              ;   * the city into the city bank (page 7, slot 3): city_col at $6000 and
  11+ C000              ;     city_map at $7000, one 8K read;
  12+ C000              ;   * the level's own map changes (x, z, cell code, city_col), for hand-made
  13+ C000              ;     layouts;
  14+ C000              ;   * the city's palette and sky colour into the Layer 2 palette, then the
  15+ C000              ;     level's own palette over it, if it has one (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP);
  16+ C000              ;   * view_r / dot_r from the draw distance (2..VIEW_R tiles).
  17+ C000              ; Loading the map also clears every cell's zombie and human marks.  The
  18+ C000              ; files must be in the ZPDATA folder beside zpolice.nex on the SD card.
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              ; Level file
  22+ C000              LVF_CITY        equ 5               ; city number
  23+ C000              LVF_REC         equ 6               ; the level record (LV_SIZE bytes)
  24+ C000              LVF_NCHG        equ LVF_REC+LV_SIZE ; number of map changes,
  25+ C000              LVF_CHG         equ LVF_NCHG+1      ; then x, z, cell code, city_col each
  26+ C000              LVF_CHG_MAX     equ 64
  27+ C000              LVF_MAX         equ LVF_CHG+4*LVF_CHG_MAX
  28+ C000              ; City file
  29+ C000              CTF_SKY         equ 14              ; sky colour: RRRGGGBB, low blue bit
  30+ C000              CTF_PAL         equ 32              ; the palette, 256 pairs
  31+ C000              CTF_DATA        equ CTF_PAL+512     ; then city_col, city_map
  32+ C000              ; Level palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP, optional: tools/levelpal.py)
  33+ C000              LPF_PAL         equ 8               ; the palette, 256 pairs
  34+ C000              LPF_SIZE        equ LPF_PAL+512
  35+ C000              LEVEL_VERSION   equ 2               ; the files' format versions (+4): the
  36+ C000              CITY_VERSION    equ 1               ;   level file's 2 (specials by wave)
  37+ C000              LPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  38+ C000              ; Vision palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPV: tools/visionpal.py)
  39+ C000              VPF_PAL         equ 8               ; 4 palettes (VM_MODES), 256 pairs each
  40+ C000              VPF_SIZE        equ VPF_PAL+4*512
  41+ C000              VPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  42+ C000              LDERR_BADFILE   equ 255             ; error code: not a valid file
  43+ C000
  44+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  45+ C000              ; A = level (1..99): load it.  Carry set on failure, A = the esxDOS error
  46+ C000              ; code or LDERR_BADFILE.  Leaves PAGE_FILE in slot 7.
  47+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48+ C000              load_level:
  49+ C000 0E 2F                ld c,'0'-1                      ; the level's two digits
  50+ C002 0C           .tens:  inc c
  51+ C003 D6 0A                sub 10
  52+ C005 30 FB                jr nc,.tens
  53+ C007 C6 3A                add a,'0'+10
  54+ C009 32 6B C2             ld (ll_level+13),a
  55+ C00C 79                   ld a,c
  56+ C00D 32 6A C2             ld (ll_level+12),a
  57+ C010 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
  58+ C014 21 5E C2             ld hl,ll_level                  ; the level file
  59+ C017 11 C2 CA             ld de,ll_lbuf
  60+ C01A 01 78 01             ld bc,LVF_MAX
  61+ C01D CD 81 E0             call fh_load
  62+ C020 D8                   ret c
  63+ C021 21 C2 CA             ld hl,ll_lbuf
  64+ C024 11 96 C2             ld de,ll_lmagic
  65+ C027 0E 02                ld c,LEVEL_VERSION
  66+ C029 CD C0 C1             call ll_check
  67+ C02C D8                   ret c
  68+ C02D 21 C8 CA             ld hl,ll_lbuf+LVF_REC           ; its record
  69+ C030 11 5B A0             ld de,level_cur
  70+ C033 01 71 00             ld bc,LV_SIZE
  71+ C036 ED B0                ldir
  72+ C038 3A C7 CA             ld a,(ll_lbuf+LVF_CITY)         ; its city file: two digits
  73+ C03B 0E 2F                ld c,'0'-1

  75+ C03E D6 0A                sub 10
  76+ C040 30 FB                jr nc,.ctens

  79+ C047 79                   ld a,c

  81+ C04B 21 71 C2             ld hl,ll_city

  83+ C050 CD 0E E0             call fh_open

  85+ C054 21 3A CC             ld hl,ll_cbuf                   ; header and palette
  86+ C057 01 20 02             ld bc,CTF_DATA

  90+ C063 21 00 60             ld hl,city_col                  ; city bank, in one read

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - load-out screen (8K page PAGE_LOADOUT, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Before the first level (newGame) and between levels, after LEVEL COMPLETE
   5+ C000              ; (loadout_go pages it in).  On the
   6+ C000              ; left, the store: every weapon type unlocked (wpn_unlocked) with the number
   7+ C000              ; in store (wpn_stock), even 0 when the only one is fitted.  On the right,
   8+ C000              ; the VTOL's 5 weapon slots and what is fitted in each.
   9+ C000              ;   1-5    select a slot (yellow)
  10+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the store list.  The highlighted
  11+ C000              ;          weapon is green if it can be fitted in the selected slot (the
  12+ C000              ;          slot allows it, wpn_fits, and one is in store), red if not; the
  13+ C000              ;          rest of the list is white.
  14+ C000              ;   SPACE  fit the highlighted weapon in the selected slot, if it can be:
  15+ C000              ;          one comes out of the store, with a full load (WCFG_LOAD), and
  16+ C000              ;          whatever was fitted there goes back into the store
  17+ C000              ;   U      unload the selected slot: its weapon back into the store, the
  18+ C000              ;          slot EMPTY (lo_unload)
  19+ C000              ;   0      done: start the level (next_level), only with a weapon in slot 1
  20+ C000              ;          (the centre slot); while it is empty 0: START LEVEL is red
  21+ C000              ; Uses the resident text routines (text.asm) and the keys page in slot 7.
  22+ C000              ;==============================================================================

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - redefine keys screen (8K page PAGE_KEYDEF, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; From the main menu (option 9, keydef_go pages it in).  Lists every control
   6+ C000              ; (K_ACTIONS of them) with its key (key_defs) and its joystick input
   7+ C000              ; (joy_defs, "-" for none; input.asm).
   8+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the list (white; highlighted green);
   9+ C000              ;          KD_VIS rows of it show, scrolling to keep the highlight in view
  10+ C000              ;   SPACE  "PRESS A KEY OR JOYSTICK", a second's pause, then the next input
  11+ C000              ;          becomes the highlighted control's key, or its joystick input if
  12+ C000              ;          it is a joystick's, unless another control already uses it: then
  13+ C000              ;          "KEY ALREADY IN USE" (for a second) and no change
  14+ C000              ;   0      every key and joystick input back to its default (key_defaults,
  15+ C000              ;          joy_defaults)
  16+ C000              ;   1      back to the main menu (menu_go), saving the definitions first if
  17+ C000              ;          they changed (kd_save; "KEYS NOT SAVED" for a second if they
  18+ C000              ;          couldn't be)
  19+ C000              ; These keys are fixed (key_code_pressed), whatever the controls are set to.
  20+ C000              ; Uses the resident text routines (text.asm) and the input page in slot 7.
  21+ C000              ;
  22+ C000              ; The definitions are kept on the SD card as ZPDATA/KEYS.ZPK (beside the level
  23+ C000              ; files): "ZPKY", KF_VERSION, K_ACTIONS, then key_defs and joy_defs (2 bytes
  24+ C000              ; each control).  start loads them (kd_load, with this page in slot 6), if the
  25+ C000              ; file is there and fits this game: else the defaults.
  26+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  27+ C000

  29+ C000              KD_NAME_COL     equ 1               ; control names,

 295+ C1F0              ; Row kd_row in colour kd_attr: HL -> an input's code, E = column, BC -> the
 296+ C1F0              ; field's blanks: the field cleared, then the input's name

 319+ C216              ; "?" if unknown)

 350+ C23D              ; Saving and loading the definitions (ZPDATA/KEYS.ZPK).  They are in the
 351+ C23D              ; input page, in slot 7, where the file handler goes too: so they go through
 352+ C23D              ; kd_buf, in this page.
 353+ C23D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 355+ C23D                                                  ;  before the strafe controls)

 357+ C23D                                                  ; joy_defs

 359+ C23D
 360+ C23D              ; Save them (the input page in slot 7, and back there after).  Carry set (A
 361+ C23D              ; = the esxDOS error) if they couldn't be.

 382+ C26C C9                   ret

 384+ C26D              ; At start-up (this page in slot 6, the file handler set up): the saved
 385+ C26D              ; definitions, if the file is there and fits this game (its size, magic,
 386+ C26D              ; version and number of controls, and every input a known one or none);
 387+ C26D              ; else the defaults stay.  Leaves the input page in slot 7.
 388+ C26D              kd_load:

# file opened: specials.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - special monsters (8K page PAGE_SPECIAL, game logic: runs at
   3+ C000              ; $C000 in slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Special monsters use the zombie records after the zombies' own (NZOMB ..
   6+ C000              ; NMON-1, zombie.asm), so they share the zombies' drawing (zombie_cell,
   7+ C000              ; fig_draw), map blips, cell marks (zflags), weapon hits and zdamage.  The
   8+ C000              ; record's type (+15) says which monster it is.  Each wave's specials come
   9+ C000              ; from the level file (level_cur, LV_WAVE_DATA: up to LV_SPEC_SLOTS types,
  10+ C000              ; SPEC_*, and how many of each), placed by spec_wave as the wave starts;
  11+ C000              ; the level's start is wave 1 (spec_init).  spec_update moves them each
  12+ C000              ; frame, after zombie_update.
  13+ C000              ;
  14+ C000              ; The ghost (ZT_GHOST, special monster id SPEC_GHOST): a stick man under a white
  15+ C000              ; sheet.  It can't attack the base.  It flies at twice the zombies' speed,
  16+ C000              ; at any angle, and up and down between the ground and the VTOL's ceiling
  17+ C000              ; (MAX_Y), over buildings lower than it.
  18+ C000              ;   * Roaming: it flies in a random direction (a random climb or descent
  19+ C000              ;     too) until something makes it turn: a building in the way or the map
  20+ C000              ;     edge (a new random direction at once), or, at its decision check
  21+ C000              ;     every GHOST_DECIDE (30) frames, a human or the VTOL within GHOST_SEE
  22+ C000              ;     (3 tiles) that it can see.
  23+ C000              ;   * Chasing: it flies straight at the nearest one it can see, aiming
  24+ C000              ;     again every GHOST_TRACK (5) frames.  If it loses sight of its target
  25+ C000              ;     (behind a taller building) or the target is gone, it roams again in a
  26+ C000              ;     random direction, back on the 30-frame cycle.
  27+ C000              ;   * Attacking: within ATTACK_R (0.1 tile) of its target on each axis it
  28+ C000              ;     stops and takes GHOST_DMG hit point every GHOST_HIT_FRAMES (10)
  29+ C000              ;     frames: from a human (HUMAN_HP) until it dies, or from the VTOL
  30+ C000              ;     (vtol_hp, VTOL_HP; at 0 it is destroyed and the game ends).  Its map blip is red
  31+ C000              ;     meanwhile (zatk_flags, zblip_red), as an attacking zombie's.  If the
  32+ C000              ;     target moves out of reach it chases it again; once the human is dead
  33+ C000              ;     it roams again.
  34+ C000              ;   * It has GHOST_HP (10) hit points; any weapon can shoot it.  Killed, it
  35+ C000              ;     fades out where it is, white to near black in 4 steps of 3 frames
  36+ C000              ;     (GM_DYING; zdamage starts it, zombie_draw colours it, g_dying ends
  37+ C000              ;     it), and can't be hit meanwhile.
  38+ C000              ; Ghost record fields, besides the zombies' (zombie.asm):
  39+ C000              ;   +11 frames to its next decision check, +16 mode (GM_*), +17 frames to
  40+ C000              ;   its next blow, +18 hit points, +21,+22 height of its feet, +23,+24 and
  41+ C000              ;   +25,+26 velocity x, z (signed 8.8 units a frame), +27,+28 the x and z
  42+ C000              ;   position fractions, +29 climb (signed units a frame), +30 target
  43+ C000              ;   (TG_NONE, TG_VTOL, or a human's index).
  44+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  45+ C000
  46+ C000              GHOST_HP        equ 10              ; hit points
  47+ C000              GHOST_DECIDE    equ 30              ; frames between decisions while roaming
  48+ C000              GHOST_TRACK     equ 5               ; and while chasing
  49+ C000              GHOST_SEE       equ 3*TILE_UNITS    ; it spots humans / the VTOL this near
  50+ C000              GHOST_HIT_FRAMES equ 10             ; frames between blows
  51+ C000              GHOST_DMG       equ 1               ; hit points a blow
  52+ C000              GHOST_CLIMB     equ 1               ; units a frame up or down
  53+ C000              GHOST_AIM_MIN   equ 80              ; (aiming: nearer counts as this far)
  54+ C000              GM_ROAM         equ 0               ; modes (+16)
  55+ C000              GM_CHASE        equ 1
  56+ C000              GM_ATTACK       equ 2
  57+ C000              GM_DYING        equ 3               ; killed: fading out (+17 frames left)
  58+ C000              GHOST_FADE_FRAMES equ 12            ; the fade: 4 steps of 3 frames
  59+ C000              TG_NONE         equ $FF             ; targets (+30)
  60+ C000              TG_VTOL         equ $FE
  61+ C000              TG_BASE         equ $C0             ; + a base tile's index (base_hp, 0..24)
  62+ C000              ; The banshee (ZT_BANSHEE, id SPEC_BANSHEE): a ghost that flies twice as
  63+ C000              ; fast, reaches BANSHEE_R (0.5 tile), does BANSHEE_DMG a blow and also
  64+ C000              ; attacks the base (the terrace and pad tiles).
  65+ C000              ; The ghoul (ZT_GHOUL, id SPEC_GHOUL, zombie.asm): a half-height zombie
  66+ C000              ; walking at five times the zombies' speed.  It is placed here (spec_wave)
  67+ C000              ; but moved, drawn and hit as a zombie.
  68+ C000              ; The lich (ZT_LICH, id SPEC_LICH): a city's boss, in the last wave of its
  69+ C000              ; last level (the level files).  Placed here (lich_init); walks as a zombie
  70+ C000              ; at 4 times the speed, drawn at LICH_H; shoots fireballs at the VTOL
  71+ C000              ; (lich_update, weapons.asm).  Each city's is harder: LICH_HP + LICH_HP_STEP
  72+ C000              ; hit points a city before it, and a shot every LICH_RATE frames,
  73+ C000              ; LICH_RATE_STEP fewer a city before it, at least LICH_RATE_MIN.  Its
  74+ C000              ; record: +18 and +23 (LICH_HP_HI) its hit points, 16 bits; +24 (LICH_WAIT)
  75+ C000              ; frames to its next shot; +25 (LICH_FRAMES) frames between.
  76+ C000              ; (Which waves have which is the level files' business: gentables.py.)
  77+ C000              BANSHEE_HP      equ 8
  78+ C000              BANSHEE_DMG     equ 5
  79+ C000              BANSHEE_R       equ TILE_UNITS/2
  80+ C000              BASE_TILES      equ (2*TERRACE_R+1)*(2*TERRACE_R+1)
  81+ C000              LICH_HP         equ 50              ; the first city's
  82+ C000              LICH_HP_STEP    equ 25              ; more a city
  83+ C000              LICH_RATE       equ 60              ; the first city's frames between shots
  84+ C000              LICH_RATE_STEP  equ 10              ; fewer a city
  85+ C000              LICH_RATE_MIN   equ 10
  86+ C000
  87+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  88+ C000              ; A level's start: every special record inactive, then wave 1's specials
  89+ C000              ; (the level's start is wave 1, as any other: spec_wave)
  90+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  91+ C000              spec_init:
